- Thành thạo ít nhất 1 ngôn ngữ Backend: Ưu tiên Python, Go, C/C++
- Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế hệ thống Microservice Architecture.
- Thành thạo một trong các hệ quản trị cơ sở dữ liệu:PostgreSQL, MongoDB...
- Hiểu rõ API design (RESTful/gRPC), bảo mật và tối ưu hiệu năng hệ thống.
- Có kinh nghiệm với: LLM Agents (GPT, Gemini, Claude...), LangChain / LangGraph/ ADK, Autogen, RAG pipelines, Vector Database(Milvus, pgvector...). Tool-use Agents (Function Calling), Memory + Planning + Multi-step reasoning systems
- Thành thạo Git/GitFlow
- Có kinh nghiệm: Docker, Kubernetes...
Ưu tiên:
+ Có kinh nghiệm trong domain: Tài chính, ngân hàng, chứng khoán
+ Hiểu biết về AI Safety, Guardrails, Model Monitoring.
+ Có kinh nghiệm tối ưu hệ thống AI cost-efficient ở production.
+ Với ứng viên Junior, Fresher: Ưu tiên các bạn xếp loại học tập loại Giỏi, Xuất sắc; GPA cao; đạt giải thưởng trong các cuộc thi chuyên môn, học sinh giỏi tỉnh, thành phố trở lên; có nghiên cứu khoa học được công bố tại các hội thảo, tạp chí quốc tế (ứng viên cần thể hiện nội dung về GPA, giải thưởng trong CV)
+ Có kiến thức, Kỹ thuật xử lý dữ liệu:NLP, Computer Vision, Speech, Video Understanding
+ Hiểu biết kiến trúc mô hình: CNN, RNN, Transformer, Attention, GNN…

Technical Program Manager
Location:
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (on-site)
Level:
Mid to senior (5+ years, at least 3 in a delivery or program role on software products)
Language:
Strong written and spoken English
Reports to:
Head of Product
Compensation:
Competitive base, performance bonus, equity participation
The role
We have several features and projects in flight at once, and most of them depend on something outside our team: a partner's system access, a client's data, a vendor's delivery, a customer trial with a fixed start date.
You own the schedule. That means the plan across all features and projects, the dates everyone has committed to, the dependencies on external parties, and keeping every stakeholder, inside and outside the company, accurately informed about where things stand.
This role does not decide what we build or how it is built. Product owns the requirements and engineering owns the technical design. You own whether it lands on the date we said, and whether everyone who needs to know that it won't has known early enough to act.
What you will do
Schedule and delivery
Own the delivery plan for all active features and projects: the timeline, the dependencies between features, and the critical path.
Collect the dates each person commits to at the start of a feature, get them approved, and hold the team to them.
Track progress against those dates daily from the work record (Jira), not from impressions. Catch a slip on a named task within days, not at the end of the timeline.
When a date is at risk, bring the options to product and engineering leadership with the trade-off stated: what scope comes out, or what date moves. Cutting scope is the first option we consider. You make sure the decision gets made and recorded; you do not make it alone.
Run the recurring delivery rhythm: the weekly status, the risk review, and the mid-build check-ins where overdue work is the agenda.
Keep the timeline and status documents current and correct. A bar showing work as in progress when it never started is a defect, and you fix it.
External stakeholders
Be the day-to-day contact for external partners, clients and vendors on everything related to schedule and delivery.
Agree deliverables and dates with each external party, write them down, and track them the same way as internal work.
Chase what we are waiting on from partners (system access, test accounts, data, sign-offs), because on most projects an external dependency is what actually sets the date.
Tell external stakeholders about changes to dates or scope before they have to ask, with the reason and the new plan.
Prepare and run status meetings with partners and clients, and follow up in writing with what was agreed, who owns each action and by when.
Plan upcoming projects with external parties: milestones, what each side delivers, and the dates they depend on, before work starts.
Reporting
Produce one concise status report for leadership each week: what shipped, what is at risk and why, what is blocked and on whom, and what decisions are needed.
Keep one accurate view of every commitment made to an external party and whether we are on track to meet it.
Using AI in your work
Use AI tools every day to do more of this job in less time: drafting status reports, meeting notes and partner updates, summarising long Slack threads and Jira activity, and preparing plans and risk lists for review.
Build and improve small automations that pull status from Jira, GitLab and Slack into reports, so time goes into chasing risks rather than copying data between tools.
Check what the tools produce before it goes out. A status report with one wrong date damages trust with a partner more than a late report does, so the accuracy of anything you send is your responsibility, whoever or whatever drafted it.
Share what works with the rest of the team, and help product, engineering and QA get more out of the same tools.
skills_and_experience:
What we look for
In priority order:
1. You find slips early.
You read a plan and see where it will break. You ask "what is this date waiting on?" before anyone else does, and you notice when a task has quietly stopped moving.
2. You report status accurately.
You report the bad news the day it becomes true, in plain words, with what it affects. "On track" means you checked, not that nobody complained. Being silent about a slip is the one failure we treat as serious.
3. You use AI to get more done, and you check its output.
You already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot in your daily work, not just occasionally. You can show us how they have made you faster or improved something you delivered: a report, a plan, a process. You also know where they go wrong (invented facts, wrong dates, confident summaries of things that were never said) and you catch those errors before anyone else sees them.
4. You manage external parties well.
You have run delivery with clients, partners or vendors who do not report to you. You can hold a partner to a date without damaging the relationship, and you know how to escalate when a dependency stalls.
5. You understand software delivery well enough to spot a bad estimate.
You do not need to write code, but you know what a spec, a merge request, a deployment and an environment are. When a developer says "almost done", you know which questions to ask.
6. You write clearly.
Most of our coordination is written and asynchronous. Your status updates, meeting notes and follow-ups need to be short, specific and hard to misread.
7. You use tools rather than spreadsheets alone.
Our status tracking is partly automated from Jira, GitLab and Slack. You are comfortable with Jira and can read a Gantt chart critically.
Requirements
5+ years in software delivery, with at least 3 as a technical program manager, delivery manager or project manager on software products.
A track record of delivering projects that involved external clients, partners or vendors, with dates you were accountable for.
Working knowledge of agile delivery, Jira (epics, tasks, estimates, time logging) and release processes.
Experience building and maintaining multi-project timelines with cross-team dependencies.
Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your work, with examples of how they improved your productivity or the quality of what you delivered.
Strong written and spoken English.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience in fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces or accounting software.
PMP, PRINCE2, CSM or similar certification (useful, not required).
Experience working with AI-assisted development teams, or building your own AI-assisted workflows or automations (scripts, agents, integrations with Jira or Slack).

Nobody writes the design for you, and nobody breaks the work into tickets for you.
Our engineers use AI coding tools every day. We expect that. What we are hiring for is the judgement around the tools: deciding what to build and how before generating any code, breaking the work down, knowing when the output is wrong, and being accountable for everything that ships under your name, whoever or whatever wrote it.
We are not looking for someone who passes requirements to an AI tool and passes the result to review. We are looking for engineers who think the problem through, plan the work, and deliver it, and who use AI to do that faster.
What you will do
Design and plan
Turn product requirements into a technical specification: functional requirements, acceptance criteria, data model, service boundaries, state changes and failure cases.

Build and deliver
Build the feature end to end, using AI tools where they help and your own judgement everywhere.
Keep the specification current as the design changes during the build, so QA and other engineers always work from the real design.
Write tests that would fail if the behaviour were wrong. Passing tests and coverage numbers are the minimum, not proof that the code works.
Review your own work before asking anyone else to, and attach the evidence when you merge: the tests, the results and what you checked.
Report progress daily and raise a slip on the day you believe it, with what it affects and what you propose.

Work with the team

job_description:
Build the AI function at an Australian engineering company. Hanoi based, hands-on, and yours to own.
This is our first artificial intelligence hire. You would report to a company director in Perth, you would be the only person doing this work, and you would build it yourself. We care more about what you have shipped and how you work with people than about how many years you have been doing it.
About us:
An environmental remediation and technology company of about forty people, based in Perth, Australia.
We clean up contaminated land, decommission industrial plant and develop our own treatment technology, including a smouldering combustion process we invented and hold the patents on.
We work across Australia and Southeast Asia, including dioxin and contaminated land projects in Vietnam with our partner there.
We are not a software company, which is exactly why this role exists.
Where you would sit:
You would work from the Hanoi office of our Vietnamese partner, an environmental consultancy we work with on projects here, with a desk alongside their team. You would not be working alone from home.
That partner would be your legal employer in Vietnam and would handle your pay, tax and social security. Western Environmental would direct your work.
Perth runs on Australian Western Standard Time, one hour ahead of Hanoi, so there is no awkward overlap and no night work.
Expect one or two trips to Perth in the first year, including time in the field, so you understand what the business actually does. We pay for those.
What you would be doing:
First, fix our own systems:
Laboratory data and field records that take a week of manual handling before anyone can analyse them.
Several thousand technical documents, standards and past reports that nobody can search properly, so the same question gets answered from scratch every time.
Regulatory reporting where the format is rigid, the content is not, and the drafting eats senior people's weeks.
Then, get forty people using what you build:
Most are technical but not software people, and some are sceptical with reason. The tools have to be good enough that people choose to use them.
You would put sensible guard rails around client and project data so people can use the tools safely.
Then, build the capability into the business. Two of our engineers want to move into this work, and developing them is part of the role. You would stay the person who designs and builds. This is not a step towards managing a team. After that we expect some of what you build to become commercial in its own right. That intention is real and the detail is undefined, and we would rather say so plainly than dress it up.
skills_and_experience:
The Stack
Claude, the Model Context Protocol and Python. A deliberate choice, made after our director spent three months building with it himself. If your background is Copilot and the Power Platform, this is not a good fit, and we would rather you knew before you applied.
About You:
You have built systems with large language models that other people use. Retrieval, agentic workflows, tool use, evaluation. Not prototypes that never left your laptop.
Strong Python.
You can hold a technical conversation in English, written and spoken, with people who are not developers. Almost everything you do will be explained in writing to engineers and scientists in Australia, so this matters more here than in most roles.
You are curious, you pick up new tools because they are better, and you are comfortable working out loud when you do not yet know the answer.
You can explain a decision, including one that turned out to be wrong.
Four to eight years is plenty. We are not counting years. If you have four and a track record of shipping, apply.
We are not looking for a researcher, a manager, or someone who needs an established platform or a large team to work against. There is no team. You would be building things yourself every week, including the unglamorous parts.
A note on AI-written applications
We use AI tools every day and we do not mind if you use one to help write your application. We do mind if what it says is not true. We check everything factual, and the first conversation is an unscripted technical discussion of the work you describe. If you cannot talk through it in detail, the application ends there.
How to apply
Apply through the Apply button on this job posting.
Please submit your CV, including additional attachments containing the following information:
Attachment 1
. Supporting Statement (max one page, in English):
Describing one system you have built using a large language model. Tell us what it did and who used it, the employer or client, the city, the size of the team, and what you personally did as distinct from what the team did.
Tell us what went wrong and what you did about it. Give us one real number: how many people used it, how much it processed, what it cost to run, or how long it took.
Attachment 2
. A Project Sample containing:
At least one accessible link to work we can review (repository, deployed application, package, or article).
One sentence about something you built and later discarded.
One thing you believe is wrong, risky, or overrated about our technology stack.
We will not shortlist an application with no link we can open.
Links to code or published work count for more than a longer CV. The company director and technical lead read every application themselves.
By submitting an application through this platform, you confirm your agreement to the consent requirements set out in Section 10 of the Candidate Privacy Notice. Candidates who wish Western Environmental Pty Ltd to retain their personal data for up to 12 months for consideration for future roles should clearly state this in their application, in accordance with Question 4 of Section 10 of the Candidate Privacy Notice.
why_love_working_here:

No existing platform, no committee and no legacy system to work around. You choose the tools.
A desk in a real office in Hanoi with colleagues around you, not a laptop at your kitchen table.
Salary reviewed at six months, with a compensation discussion at twelve. Local employment with proper entitlements, tax and social security.
Real problems attached to physical work: contaminated sites, industrial decommissioning and treatment technology we own, which you are welcome to go and see.
One or two paid trips to Perth in the first year, including field time.

job_title: Staff AI Engineer - Report to CTO
address: The Grace Tower, 71, đường Hoàng Văn Thái, Tân Phú,, Tan My, Ho Chi Minh
skills: LLM, Python
job_domain: E-commerce Transportation, Logistics and Warehouse Software Products and Web Services AI Software & Services
job_description:
WE NEED YOU ON OUR TEAM!
We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to be the senior technical authority for AI across the organization. This is not a people-management role – it’s a consulting and architecture role with organization-wide reach: you design AI solutions, set the standards other engineers build to, drive evaluation discipline, and shape how AI enters our products from the design phase onward. You report directly to the CTO and multiply the impact of every squad working with AI.
What You’ll Do
Advise and design AI solutions across the full spectrum – from single LLM calls to complex multi-agent infrastructure – recommending implementation approaches that account for fallbacks, cost/latency budgets, and rate-limit constraints (throttling, TPM/RPM).
Architect agentic systems with the right structure for the problem: MCP server design, deterministic workflows, single agents with tool access, orchestrator–worker or A2A multi-agent topologies.
Own the evaluation practice that drives technical decisions: eval sets, scoring rubrics, and regression measurement for non-deterministic outputs – and use that evidence to settle when to prompt, when to RAG, when to fine-tune, and when to build an agent, so architecture choices are backed by measurement rather than intuition.
Partner with Product from the design phase: consult on where AI genuinely adds value in a feature, what’s feasible at what cost, and what the failure modes will look like – so AI capability shapes the product spec instead of being retrofitted after.
Forecast the direction of AI in the next 2-3 years, and start to take actions today so Perform.AI remains technologically relevant in that future.
Raise the technical level of engineers across squads: review their designs and code before implementation, define shared standards they follow (prompt conventions, eval-driven development), design and deliver internal AI training programs, and make architecture decisions the whole team builds on.
skills_and_experience:
WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING ALONG!
Core Qualifications
8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building and operating LLM-based systems in production.
Hands-on experience designing and running LLM-based systems in production – beyond API calls: handling fallbacks, cost/latency trade-offs, rate limits (TPM/RPM), and structured output reliability at scale.
Experience building multi-step agentic systems and choosing the right topology for the problem – using frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph or equivalents (LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, Claude Agents SDK), with working knowledge of MCP, context/state management, and agent failure modes.
Demonstrated evaluation discipline for non-deterministic systems: building eval sets, defining scoring rubrics (including LLM-as-judge approaches), measuring regression – using tools like LangSmith, Langfuse, or equivalents – and using eval evidence to drive architecture decisions (prompt vs. RAG vs. fine-tune vs. agent).
Strong backend fundamentals with the depth to drive the tech stack, not just work within it: expert-level Python, distributed systems, high-volume data pipelines, and the judgment to select and standardize frameworks, libraries, and infrastructure for AI workloads across the team.
Nice to Have
Experience in logistics, e-commerce, or other high-volume data domains.
Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference talks.
Experience fine-tuning models (managed fine-tuning APIs or open-weight approaches like LoRA/PEFT) and judging when fine-tuning beats prompting or RAG on cost and quality.
Experience across the LLM deployment spectrum: working with managed cloud LLM services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent) – quotas, regional availability, model version management – familiarity with deploying open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Qwen from Hugging Face) on your own infrastructure with an understanding of the cost/control trade-offs between the two.

We believe the productivity multiplication of AI doesn’t just come from individual applications but also from an entire system that embraces it into every fabric.
An environment where everybody never stops growing and focuses on succeeding – we continuously work with you on your strengths and weaknesses across many important dimensions and look at ways for you to address them and further your development.
Join a passionate, global team at Perform.AI where you can continuously develop your skills and actively drive our mission and international success.

job_title: Division Principal Games Programmer (Unreal Engine, AI)
address: Richmond Building, 207C Nguyen Xi, Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh
skills: Games, AI, Unreal Engine, C++, C#
job_description:
What you will focus on
This role exists because reactive execution is no longer enough. The OTT programming division needs a technical authority who can shift the team's positioning from "a team that delivers what it is asked to build" to "a technical partners that other studios actively seek out because of the value it brings to a game's success." That shift requires someone who can set a long-term technical vision, build scalable production ecosystems across mobile, PC, and console, and drive focused R&D including applied AI in game development, while simultaneously ensuring flawless deliveries across multiple live and co-development projects.
The real challenge is dual: you are building toward the future while keeping current production healthy. You will need to anticipate what partner studios will need before they ask, identify and close skill gaps across a team of around 35 to 40 programmers, and establish the kind of technical standards that make this studio a reference point across the organization, not just a capable executor.
What it means on a daily basis​
Monitor the technical health of multiple concurrent projects, working closely with technical leads to surface risks early, prevent bottlenecks, and keep deliveries on track.
Define and enforce studio-wide coding standards, architectural patterns, and engineering workflows, and drive their adoption across programming teams.
Lead high-impact R&D initiatives, with particular focus on AI applied to game development, and ensure successful integration of outcomes into production pipelines.
Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentoring to programmers, conducting periodic competency assessments and building clear development paths.
Act as the primary technical counterpart for co-development partner studios, aligning on architecture, tooling, style guides, and Unreal toolchain standardization across shared pipelines.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Game Design, Art, and Production to improve how programming integrates with other disciplines and contributes to overall product quality.
Strategic resource planning and project allocation in partnership with the Studio Technical Director.
What success will look like​
Within your first year, you will have made a visible and assessable impact on at least one co-development project or on a strategic technical mission defined in alignment with the studio's long-term vision. That impact will be confirmed through calibration with multiple stakeholders across the organization, not through self-assessment alone.
Who you would be working with​
You will report to the Studio Technical Director and operate across a programming department of around 35 to 40 people, spanning multiple seniority levels and allocated to live service and co-development projects on mobile, PC, and console platforms.
Your key collaborators include department heads and team leads across Game Design, Art, and Production, as well as Studio Directors and the Studio Manager. You will also work directly with Technical Managers and Technical Directors from co-development partner studios.
Your recruitment journey
Screen Call
with a Recruiter
First Interview
with the Studio Technical Director and Division Principal/Manager
Second Interview
with Studio Manager and HR Director
Final interview
with a Technical Director from a sister studio
Where this role can take you
If the opportunity arises and the qualifications are in place, this position is a direct pathway to the Studio Technical Director role. That outcome is not guaranteed, but it is a realistic evolution for the right person.
skills_and_experience:
WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED​
Proven hands-on expertise in game development across multiple genres and platforms.
Demonstrated ability to design and lead large-scale technical systems, covering areas such as 3D rendering, AI gameplay systems, online and network scalability, and cloud infrastructure.
High proficiency in Unreal Engine 5 and programming languages such as C++ and C#.
Practical experience deploying AI and LLM-based tools in a production context.
A track record of leading R&D initiatives from exploration through to production integration.
Demonstrated leadership of multi-disciplinary programming teams, including identifying skill gaps, building development plans, and raising the collective output quality of a department rather than just individual projects.
The ability to communicate technical direction clearly to senior leadership, partner studio counterparts, and non-technical collaborators, and to influence decisions at a strategic level while maintaining alignment across stakeholders.
WHO YOU ARE
You think in systems and timelines, resolve production problems without losing sight of the architectural implications.
You set direction rather than wait for it, anticipate technical needs and build proactive solutions before being asked.
You lead by raising the floor, elevate others by developing technical talent and closing skill gaps.
You hold your ground in complex stakeholder environments, with clear, inclusive communication.
You are hands-on by choice, not obligation, tackle complex technical challenges to build earned credibility.
You balance technical rigor with product thinking to ensure sustainable creativity.
You remain steady and sharp when organizational conditions and priorities shift.

address: 878 SW 12th Avenue, Pompano Beach, FL 33069
skills: Software Architecture, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSql, ReactJS, English
job_domain: Insurance IT Services and IT Consulting Telecommunication Software Products and Web Services AI Software & Services
job_description:
We are building a connected platform for an insurance business: a CRM, a live calling and routing system, and AI-assisted workflows. Parts of the system are already serving real users and calls. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead to turn this working foundation into a reliable, maintainable product that can be released and expanded with confidence.
You will work directly with the founder, who owns the product vision and business priorities. You will own the technical approach: understand the existing systems, make architecture decisions, write and review code, guide other developers, plan safe releases, and take responsibility for resolving production issues.
The platform spans a React/Next.js and TypeScript CRM; Supabase/PostgreSQL, SQL functions and Edge Functions; and Python voice services connected to LiveKit, Twilio SIP, transcription and AI providers. Calls and customer records must remain accurate across these systems. We also operate separate business databases that require consistent changes without mixing customer data.
Your first priorities will be to map the current architecture, identify the few issues that materially threaten reliability or delivery, establish clear testing and release practices, and lead the team through production-ready milestones. This is an implementation role, not an advisory-only architecture position.
You will lead the technical delivery of the platform while remaining hands-on across frontend, backend and production systems. A major part of the role is bringing the CRM interface to an enterprise-ready standard: improving layouts and workflows, establishing consistent components and design patterns, and implementing polished, accessible screens—not just making them function.
skills_and_experience:
Must have
Substantial experience personally building and leading production web applications—not only managing developers.
Strong TypeScript/React experience and the ability to work across frontend, APIs, PostgreSQL and backend services.
Experience designing reliable event-driven integrations: handling missing, duplicated and out-of-order events without losing or corrupting records.
Strong SQL, database migration, access-control, data-integrity and production-debugging skills.
A track record of leading releases, reviewing code, improving tests and investigating incidents using logs and live evidence.
Clear written and spoken English, sound technical judgment, and willingness to explain tradeoffs to a nontechnical founder.
Reliable overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours; the exact schedule should be agreed before hiring.
Especially valuable
Python/FastAPI, Supabase, Next.js, real-time communications, SIP/telephony, Twilio or LiveKit.
Experience with AI-assisted products, speech transcription, monitoring and alerting.
Experience leading a small distributed team while remaining hands-on.
why_love_working_here: You will have genuine technical ownership, direct access to the founder, and the chance to shape a product that is already being used—not spend months on a presentation that may never launch. The work crosses CRM, real-time voice, AI and operational reliability. We value clear thinking, honest reporting, practical solutions and proof that a feature works for real users.

job_description:
OVERVIEW
Chuyên viên SecOps chịu trách nhiệm vận hành các chương trình giám sát, săn lùng mối đe dọa và ứng cứu sự cố an ninh bảo mật nhằm đảm bảo an toàn cho hệ thống CNTT của MDP. Vị trí này đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc phát hiện sớm, phân tích và xử lý các mối đe dọa an ninh mạng, giảm thiểu rủi ro và đảm bảo sự liên tục trong hoạt động kinh doanh.
Responsibilities
Giám sát & Xử lý Cảnh báo (Security Monitoring & Incident Response)
Vận hành hệ thống SIEM (ví dụ: Splunk, Elastic SIEM): Giám sát liên tục các sự kiện an ninh trên toàn bộ hệ thống (logs từ máy chủ, ứng dụng, thiết bị mạng, cloud).
Phân tích và điều tra cảnh báo: Tiếp nhận, phân loại và phân tích sâu các cảnh báo bảo mật từ SIEM, EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response), IDS/IPS, WAF để xác định các mối đe dọa thực sự (true positives).
Ứng phó sự cố: Thực hiện các bước ứng phó ban đầu theo quy trình (playbook), bao gồm việc cô lập hệ thống bị ảnh hưởng, ngăn chặn các hành vi tấn công và thu thập bằng chứng số.
Tối ưu hóa quy tắc phát hiện: Tinh chỉnh và phát triển các quy tắc (detection rules) mới để tăng độ chính xác của hệ thống giám sát, giảm thiểu cảnh báo sai (false positives).
Quản lý Lỗ hổng Bảo mật (Vulnerability Management)
Quét và nhận diện lỗ hổng: Sử dụng các công cụ chuyên dụng (ví dụ: Nessus, Qualys) để thường xuyên rà quét lỗ hổng trên các hệ thống máy chủ, ứng dụng và thiết bị mạng.
Phân tích và xếp hạng rủi ro: Đánh giá mức độ nghiêm trọng của các lỗ hổng được phát hiện, kết hợp với bối cảnh kinh doanh để ưu tiên các hoạt động khắc phục.
Phối hợp khắc phục: Làm việc chặt chẽ với các đội ngũ vận hành hệ thống (Ops) để theo dõi, đôn đốc và hỗ trợ quá trình vá lỗi, đảm bảo các lỗ hổng được xử lý trong thời gian quy định (SLA).
Tình báo An ninh mạng (Threat Intelligence - TI)
Thu thập và phân tích thông tin: Chủ động theo dõi, thu thập thông tin về các mối đe dọa mới, các chiến thuật, kỹ thuật và quy trình (TTPs) của hacker từ các nguồn tin cậy (open-source và thương mại).
Tích hợp TI vào vận hành: Áp dụng thông tin tình báo để cải thiện khả năng phòng thủ, ví dụ như cập nhật danh sách các IP độc hại (IOCs) vào Firewall/SIEM, hay triển khai các quy tắc phát hiện mới dựa trên TTPs của các nhóm tấn công đang hoạt động.
Săn lùng mối đe dọa (Threat Hunting): Dựa trên giả thuyết và dữ liệu tình báo, chủ động tìm kiếm các dấu hiệu bất thường, các hành vi đáng ngờ chưa bị hệ thống tự động phát hiện.
Tuân thủ & Báo cáo (Compliance & Reporting)
Phối hợp kiểm toán: Hỗ trợ các hoạt động đánh giá, kiểm toán an ninh nội bộ và bên ngoài (ví dụ: PCI DSS, ISO 27001) bằng cách cung cấp bằng chứng, log và các tài liệu liên quan.
Đảm bảo tuân thủ chính sách: Giám sát và thực thi việc tuân thủ các chính sách, quy trình bảo mật đã được ban hành trong toàn tổ chức.
Xây dựng báo cáo: Định kỳ tạo các báo cáo về tình hình an ninh, số lượng sự cố, trạng thái lỗ hổng và các chỉ số hiệu suất quan trọng (KPIs) để gửi cho cấp quản lý.
Endpoint Security
Quản trị và tối ưu hóa các nền tảng EDR/XDR (như CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint).
Thiết lập các chính sách ngăn chặn (Prevention policies), loại trừ (Exclusions) và giám sát liên tục.
Thực hiện Threat Hunting chủ động trên các thiết bị đầu cuối để phát hiện các hành vi bất thường chưa có chữ ký (signature).
DFIR (Digital Forensics & Incident Response)
Phản ứng nhanh với các cảnh báo bảo mật mức độ cao.
Thực hiện thu thập dữ liệu bộ nhớ (RAM), ổ đĩa và log hệ thống để phân tích pháp chứng.
Phân tích mã độc (Malware Analysis) cơ bản để hiểu hành vi và tác động của chúng.
Xây dựng báo cáo điều tra sau sự cố (Post-Incident Report) và đề xuất biện pháp khắc phục triệt để.

job_description:
The Growth Analytics & Business Insights Analyst supports Growth & Loyalty activities through data analysis, performance reporting, and business insights.
The role focuses on Loyalty, Loyalty-related Trade Marketing programs, customer behavior, and related digital marketing journeys. Working under the direction of the Growth Marketing Supervisor, the Analyst will prepare reports and dashboards, analyze campaign and customer performance, and help the team identify opportunities for improvement.
The Analyst is also encouraged to raise questions and provide alternative perspectives when supported by data.
Key Responsibilities
Growth, Loyalty & Customer Analytics
Analyze customer, transaction, membership, campaign, and digital interaction data to support Growth Marketing activities.
Monitor key customer metrics, including acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, purchase frequency, spending, churn, and customer lifecycle.
Evaluate Loyalty performance across membership tiers, customer segments, point earning and redemption, voucher usage, and promotional participation.
Analyze Trade Marketing activities and digital customer journeys by relevant dimensions such as customer segment, campaign, channel, store, product, and time period.
Conduct segmentation, cohort, funnel, trend, and behavioral analysis based on business requirements.
Reporting & Performance Analysis
Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports for Loyalty, Trade Marketing, digital journeys, and other Growth Marketing initiatives.
Develop and maintain dashboards based on KPI frameworks and reporting requirements provided by the Growth Marketing Supervisor.
Track campaign performance against agreed targets, historical results, or reference groups, and summarize key outcomes after implementation.
Highlight material changes, unusual movements, funnel drop-offs, risks, and areas that may require further analysis.
Support the improvement and automation of recurring reports to reduce manual work and improve reporting efficiency.
Business Insights & Recommendations
Interpret analytical results and translate them into clear and relevant business insights.
Help identify customer behaviors, performance drivers, business risks, and potential growth opportunities.
Explain what changed, identify possible contributing factors, and suggest areas for further monitoring or analysis.
Present findings in a concise, business-friendly format for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Raise questions or propose alternative interpretations when business assumptions are not sufficiently supported by data.
Data Quality, Documentation & Collaboration
Validate source data, business rules, calculation logic, and reporting outputs before sharing results.
Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate with BI, Data, Technology, or system owners when support is required.
Maintain clear documentation of KPI definitions, calculation methods, data sources, and reporting logic within the Growth Marketing scope.
Work closely with Growth Marketing, CRM, Loyalty, Operations, Finance, BI, Data, and other relevant teams.
Follow company policies regarding customer data privacy, data security, access control, and responsible data usage.
skills_and_experience:
Qualifications & Experience
4+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Business Insights, CRM Analytics, Marketing Analytics, or a similar role.
Experience using data to support business decisions, customer analysis, campaign evaluation, or performance reporting.
Hands-on experience developing dashboards and preparing recurring or ad-hoc reports for business teams.
Experience working with customer, transaction, CRM, Loyalty, campaign, or digital journey data is preferred.
Experience in F&B, retail, e-commerce, consumer services, or other transaction-driven businesses is an advantage.
Technical & Analytical Skills
Required
Strong SQL skills for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
Good proficiency in at least one visualization tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, or Superset.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for data analysis and business reporting.
Familiarity with segmentation, cohort analysis, funnel analysis, trend analysis, and campaign performance analysis.
Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, and data presentation skills.
Nice to Have
Knowledge of statistical analysis, test and control groups, or A/B testing.
Proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation or reporting automation.
Familiarity with data warehouse concepts or cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Redshift, or ClickHouse.
Understanding of Loyalty programs, CRM, customer lifecycle management, promotional effectiveness, or digital conversion funnels.

job_description:
Thiết kế, triển khai và vận hành toàn bộ hệ thống cơ sở dữ liệu MySQL và MongoDB cho sàn giao dịch crypto, đảm bảo hệ thống hoạt động ổn định 24/7 với uptime tối thiểu 99.9%.
Thiết kế schema và data model cho các nghiệp vụ trading engine, order book, wallet management và KYC/AML; triển khai, quản lý MySQL Cluster (InnoDB Cluster, Group Replication, ProxySQL) và MongoDB Cluster (Replica Sets, Sharded Clusters), đảm bảo high availability, automatic failover và khả năng xử lý tải cao.
Tối ưu hiệu năng truy vấn thông qua query optimization, index tuning và execution plan analysis, đảm bảo latency thấp cho matching engine và order processing.

job_description:
We are re-platforming a
national public-sector system in the EU
: ~750 screens of a legacy client-server 4GL (Uniface), rebuilt as a modern Java/Spring + React application on top of an Oracle database.
The hardest question on this project is not "does the new code work" — it is
"does the new system do exactly what the old one does"
. Every migration wave has to clear that bar before it goes live. At 750 screens and thousands of business rules, that cannot be proven by hand — it has to be proven by a
test system
: an automated, repeatable verification machine that compares old and new on every wave.
That machine does not exist yet.
You build it.
You design the test architecture, you set up the AI-driven workflow that turns business rules into executable tests at scale, you lead two QA/BA engineers who work inside that system, and you make the go / no-go call for every wave. You work from the specification owned by the BA Lead — and you send it back when it is not testable.
What you will do
Design and build the test system from the ground up
— the automation framework (API and UI), the test data strategy, the parity-comparison engine that runs the same scenario against the legacy system and the new one and diffs the results, and the CI pipeline that runs all of it per wave.
Build the AI-driven QA workflow
— an AI-first pipeline from business rule → test case → automated test → execution report. Use AI coding agents to generate and maintain test code. You own the prompts, the guardrails, and the review step that keeps AI output trustworthy.
Own the test strategy
— decide what gets tested, at which level (API, UI, data), with what data, and what blocks a release. Set it once for the program and adapt it per wave.
Own the quality gate for each migration wave
— define the exit criteria, run the verification, and make the go / no-go call on whether the new system matches the old one. Your word decides whether a wave ships.
Lead the QA function
— two QA/BA engineers report to you. You assign work, prioritize, review test code and coverage critically, and grow them into automation and AI-assisted testing.
Turn the BA Lead's specification into a test oracle
— read each business rule, decide how it will be proven, and send it back when it is ambiguous. On this project the specification and the test oracle are the same artifact, so you and the BA Lead work as a pair.
Verify parity against the legacy system
— screen by screen and record by record, including direct data checks in Oracle, and make every difference visible and explainable.
Own UAT execution and defect triage
— plan the UAT sessions with the client together with the BA Lead, run them, and drive defects through to closure and sign-off.
Keep everything traceable
— every test maps back to a business rule, a screen, and a wave, generated and maintained by the system rather than by hand. Public-sector delivery is audited; the traceability matrix is a deliverable, not paperwork.
skills_and_experience:
5+ years in QA / test automation on complex business systems, including 2+ years leading a QA team or function (+3 yoe- Middle level)
— you have owned a release decision, not just executed a test plan
You have built a test automation system before, not just used one
— framework design, test data management, reporting, CI integration; you can show something you designed from zero that a team then worked inside
Hands-on automation depth
— Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured, Postman/Newman or similar, plus solid programming in at least one of Java, TypeScript or Python; you write and review test code daily
AI-first way of working, proven in QA
— you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) to generate and refactor test code, LLMs to derive test cases from requirements, and you know where they fail: you have built prompts, review loops and guardrails around them, and you can tell a good AI-generated test from a plausible-looking wrong one
Test strategy ownership
— you have decided what gets tested, at which level, and what blocks a release, and defended that decision to a client or a delivery manager
Strong SQL
— you check data in Oracle yourself rather than asking a developer to check it for you
Experience leading a small QA team
— task assignment, prioritization, code and coverage review, mentoring engineers into automation
Strong English
— you will run UAT with the client, write test strategy documents, and report readiness to an international public-sector client
Nice to have
Agentic / MCP-based test tooling
— e.g. Playwright MCP, browser agents for exploratory testing, LLM-based visual or output comparison, self-healing locators
Data comparison / reconciliation tooling
— comparing large Oracle datasets between two systems, golden-record approaches, record-level diffing at scale
Experience with a legacy migration
— parallel run, cutover, wave-based rollout, or reconciliation between an old and a new system
CI/CD experience — GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar, running suites on OpenShift / Kubernetes
Contract and API testing at scale (OpenAPI-driven test generation, consumer-driven contracts)
Accessibility testing against WCAG — it is a legal requirement for EU public-sector systems
Performance testing basics (JMeter, k6 or similar)

Gia nhập đội ngũ SOC của VPS, bạn sẽ trực tiếp tham gia giám sát, điều tra và ứng phó sự cố an toàn thông tin cho hệ thống giao dịch chứng khoán và hạ tầng công nghệ trọng yếu, góp phần bảo vệ tính an toàn, liên tục và ổn định của một trong những hệ thống tài chính có yêu cầu cao về bảo mật và tính sẵn sàng.
2. MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC
Chủ trì phân tích, điều tra và xử lý các sự cố an toàn thông tin có mức độ nghiêm trọng hoặc phạm vi ảnh hưởng lớn.
Xác định nguyên nhân, phương thức tấn công, phạm vi ảnh hưởng và đề xuất phương án cô lập, khắc phục, phòng ngừa tái diễn.
Đưa ra đánh giá chuyên môn và phương án xử lý đối với các cảnh báo, sự kiện phức tạp được chuyển lên từ các cấp vận hành trước đó.
Thực hiện phân tích log, điều tra dấu vết và truy tìm các hành vi bất thường hoặc dấu hiệu xâm nhập trên hệ thống.
Chủ động tìm kiếm, phát hiện các mối đe dọa tiềm ẩn, hoạt động tấn công có chủ đích và các nguy cơ ảnh hưởng đến an toàn hệ thống.
Chủ trì hoặc tham gia xây dựng, rà soát và tối ưu các kịch bản giám sát, luật cảnh báo và cơ chế phát hiện trên các nền tảng bảo mật.
Khai thác, phân tích thông tin về các mối đe dọa để phục vụ công tác giám sát, điều tra và ứng phó sự cố.
Đánh giá hiệu quả của hệ thống giám sát và đề xuất các giải pháp nhằm nâng cao khả năng phát hiện, cảnh báo và xử lý sự cố.
Xây dựng và cập nhật quy trình, kịch bản ứng phó đối với các tình huống mất an toàn thông tin.
Điều phối quá trình ứng phó sự cố; phối hợp với các đơn vị CNTT, Hạ tầng, Ứng dụng, Nghiệp vụ và các bên liên quan để kiểm soát và khắc phục sự cố.
Tham gia đánh giá rủi ro an toàn thông tin đối với các hệ thống, ứng dụng hoặc giải pháp công nghệ mới.
Tư vấn chuyên môn cho các đơn vị liên quan trong việc xác định nguyên nhân, mức độ ảnh hưởng và phương án xử lý các vấn đề an toàn thông tin.
Thực hiện các nhiệm vụ chuyên môn khác theo phân công.

job_description:
Prefer immediate employment / ƯU TIÊN ĐI LÀM NGAY
Your main activities
Develop back-end APIs using
Java (Spring Boot)
and/or
Go
— both are used across our new projects.
Design and work with relational databases (
PostgreSQL
) — schema, migrations, queries.
Integrate with third-party service providers over REST and SOAP, and make those integrations resilient when the provider is slow or down.
Work with
Kafka
for asynchronous processing and event-driven flows.
Develop user interfaces in
JavaScript / TypeScript / HTML5 / CSS3
using
Angular or ReactJS
, responsive on desktop and mobile browsers.
Consume your own APIs from the client, including
streaming responses
where results arrive progressively rather than all at once.
Work with shared packages in a monorepo — shared business logic, generated API clients and a design system.
Test, commit and integrate your code with our online products.
Work as part of an AI agent team
— set up and run AI agents that implement, review and verify work under your direction.
skills_and_experience:
Your Skills and Experience
You do not need to be equally strong on both sides. You
do
need to be genuinely productive on both — able to take a feature from the database to the screen without handing it over halfway.
Back-end
Experienced with
Java (Spring Boot, Java 17+)
and/or
Go
. Strong in one and willing to work in the other is fine; strong in both is better.
Solid understanding of
REST API design
, and of documenting an API as a contract (OpenAPI).
Working knowledge of
relational databases
— transactions, indexing, and why a query is slow.
Experience integrating
third-party APIs
: timeouts, retries, and knowing which operations are safe to retry and which are not.
Front-end
Experienced with
Angular or ReactJS
and
TypeScript
.
Being able to work in both is a big plus
— we run both, and people who move between them are the ones who see the pattern instead of the framework.
Experience with micro-frontends
— module boundaries, independent deployment, and the versioning and caching problems that come with them.
Solid
HTML5 / CSS3
and responsive layout skills.
Experience handling
server state
properly (TanStack Query, SWR, RxJS or similar) — not everything in a global store.
Experience building
forms and data tables at real complexity
— validation, server-side errors, multi-step flows.
Awareness of accessibility and keyboard interaction as a default, not a retrofit.
A product mindset about UI/UX.
You care how the screen actually feels to use, and when a design or a requirement looks wrong you
say so
instead of building it silently. We would rather have the argument before the sprint than the rework after it.
General
Comfortable with
automated testing
on both sides as part of your normal workflow, not as a separate phase.
Strong interest in software design, programming and testing.
Prefer immediate employment.
Working with AI — required, not optional
Proficient, hands-on experience with AI coding agents
in daily development work.
Able to set up an AI agent team
— define agent roles, skills and gates so a feature can be split across several agents and still come back consistent.
Proficient in prompt engineering
— you can turn a vague requirement into instructions an agent executes reliably, and keep it on the project's conventions.
Experience setting up an agent harness
: project-level instruction files, custom commands and skills, sub-agents with scoped tools and permissions, hooks for the rules that must always hold.
Loop engineering
— you build an objective verifier and let the agent iterate against it instead of reviewing output by eye. On the back end that means unit tests, type checks and architecture or lint gates;
turning a rule you would otherwise repeat in code review into an automated check is the core skill.
On the front end it means more than "it compiles" — you also give the agent a way to
observe the rendered result
(for example a browser-automation screenshot or an accessibility snapshot). Candidates who have closed that visual loop are rare and we want them.
Experience setting up AI code review
— automated review in the pull-request flow, tuned so it catches real defects instead of producing noise everyone learns to ignore.
Experience building an autonomous agent team
— agents that plan, implement, review and verify, with a human at the gates — is a strong advantage.
Critical evaluation of AI output.
You can spot a diff that looks correct and quietly breaks a business rule, and a component that renders fine in the demo and falls apart on real data or a slow network.

Lead Cyber Security Engineer là người dẫn dắt kỹ thuật (technical lead) của nhóm, chịu trách nhiệm về kiến trúc an ninh thông tin (security architecture), định hướng công nghệ, chất lượng triển khai các giải pháp bảo mật, đồng thời mentor và phát triển năng lực cho các thành viên trong nhóm.

Xây dựng security reference architecture, security baseline, design pattern cho các hệ thống, dự án mới trước khi go-live.
Đánh giá, lựa chọn và định hướng công nghệ/giải pháp an ninh thông tin phù hợp với chiến lược phát triển của công ty (WAF, DLP, CASB, CSPM, CWPP, IAM/PAM, Secrets Management…).

job_description:
Tổng quan vị trí/
Position Summary:
Dẫn dắt năng lực kiểm thử xâm nhập (Offensive Security) cho toàn bộ ứng dụng Web, API, Mobile-backend và ứng dụng tích hợp AI/LLM của Công ty/Công ty thành viên.
Xây dựng và vận hành mô hình kiểm thử liên tục (CTEM/PTaaS): kết hợp kiểm thử thủ công chuyên sâu với tự động hóa và tích hợp vào CI/CD theo mô hình DevSecOps.
Thực hiện và điều phối kiểm thử xâm nhập trên môi trường ứng dụng Web/API, hạ tầng cloud-native (Container, Kubernetes, Serverless) và chuỗi cung ứng phần mềm.
Chuyển hóa kết quả kiểm thử thành khuyến nghị giảm thiểu rủi ro cho Blue Team/SOC và các nhóm phát triển; chủ trì hoạt động Purple Team.
Chuẩn hóa phương pháp luận (OWASP WSTG/ASVS, PTES, NIST SP 800-115), quy trình và bảo đảm tuân thủ ISO/IEC 27001:2022, PCI DSS 4.x, Luật An ninh mạng và Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân số 91/2025/QH15.
Quản lý nguồn lực, phát triển đội ngũ và báo cáo mức độ phơi nhiễm rủi ro ứng dụng cho Ban lãnh đạo.
Mô tả công việc/
Job Descriptions:
1. Xây dựng và vận hành năng lực kiểm thử tự động hóa – liên tục
Triển khai, vận hành nền tảng và bộ công cụ kiểm thử (Burp Suite Professional/Enterprise, ZAP, Nuclei, SAST/DAST/SCA/IAST).
Tích hợp kiểm thử bảo mật vào CI/CD pipeline (shift-left), quản lý SBOM và rủi ro chuỗi cung ứng phần mềm.
Nghiên cứu CVE mới, viết PoC/mã khai thác, phát triển công cụ nội bộ (Python/Go) và tự động hóa quy trình kiểm thử.
Ứng dụng AI/LLM để tăng tốc phân tích và soạn báo cáo, đồng thời kiểm soát rủi ro rò rỉ dữ liệu khi sử dụng AI.
Tư vấn cấp trên về công nghệ, giải pháp an toàn ứng dụng mới cho các đơn vị trong hệ sinh thái.
2. Kiểm thử xâm nhập ứng dụng Web, API và ứng dụng tích hợp AI
Kiểm thử thủ công chuyên sâu theo OWASP WSTG/ASVS: lỗi logic nghiệp vụ, IDOR/BOLA, race condition, SSRF, deserialization, HTTP request smuggling, tấn công phía client.
Kiểm thử API (REST/GraphQL/gRPC/Webhook) theo OWASP API Security Top 10; kiểm thử phân quyền, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SAML, JWT, SSO và luồng xác thực không mật khẩu (passkey).
Kiểm thử ứng dụng tích hợp AI/LLM và Agentic AI: prompt injection, rò rỉ dữ liệu qua RAG, lạm dụng quyền của agent/tool, kiểm soát kết nối MCP.
Cung cấp bằng chứng khai thác (PoC), xếp hạng rủi ro theo CVSS 4.0 gắn với tác động nghiệp vụ; thực hiện retest xác nhận khắc phục (Remediation Verification).
Phối hợp các bộ phận liên quan xây dựng phương án vá lỗi và tái đánh giá.
3. Hỗ trợ Blue Team/SOC nâng cao năng lực phòng thủ (Purple Team)
Chuyển kịch bản tấn công thành detection use case theo MITRE ATT&CK; đo lường khả năng phát hiện và phản ứng.
Tư vấn kiến trúc phòng thủ ứng dụng: WAF/WAAP, API Gateway, chống bot và lạm dụng API, nguyên tắc Zero Trust.
Theo dõi vòng đời khắc phục lỗ hổng (MTTR), cảnh báo sớm các rủi ro phơi nhiễm trên bề mặt tấn công Internet (EASM).
4. Chuẩn hóa quy trình, phương pháp luận và tuân thủ
Biên soạn, rà soát định kỳ quy trình, quy định, checklist và mẫu báo cáo kiểm thử song ngữ Việt – Anh.
Bảo đảm hoạt động kiểm thử tuân thủ ISO/IEC 27001:2022, PCI DSS 4.0.1, NIST CSF 2.0, Luật An ninh mạng, Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân số 91/2025/QH15 và quy định chuyên ngành.
Quản trị, sao lưu, nâng cấp hạ tầng lab kiểm thử; bảo vệ nghiêm ngặt dữ liệu nhạy cảm phát sinh trong quá trình kiểm thử..
5. Quản lý nhóm, điều phối nguồn lực và báo cáo
Phân công, giám sát chất lượng và soát xét toàn bộ báo cáo trước khi phát hành.
Xây dựng lộ trình phát triển năng lực, chương trình đào tạo và đánh giá hiệu quả công việc của nhóm.
Quản lý nhà thầu kiểm thử độc lập, chương trình Bug Bounty/VDP và ngân sách công cụ.
Báo cáo dashboard rủi ro ứng dụng và mức độ phơi nhiễm cho Ban lãnh đạo theo định kỳ.

FE Credit is looking for a
Cloud Security Engineer Expert
with over 6 years of experience to join the Information Security team. In this role, you will be primarily responsible for designing, building, monitoring, and optimizing the security architecture across our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, OCI, VNG Cloud). Given the nature of the financial industry, this position requires a proactive, prevention-oriented mindset and deep understanding of strict compliance standards and regulations to protect data integrity and customer assets.
II. Key Responsibilities
Design & Architecture:
Design and implement security architecture, establish secure network zone designs (Landing Zones), identity and access management (IAM), and security controls across the multi-cloud environment (AWS, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure – OCI, VNG Cloud).
Monitoring & Early Detection:
Build, configure, and optimize the security monitoring ecosystem (SIEM, SOAR, CloudTrail, OCI Logging) to detect, analyze, and respond promptly to cloud security incidents 24/7.
Vulnerability & Configuration Management:
Manage and operate CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management) and CWPP (Cloud Workload Protection Platform) solutions to continuously scan for vulnerabilities and control misconfigurations across cloud platforms.
Data Security:
Implement data encryption solutions (at rest/in transit), key management (KMS/HSM), and data loss prevention (DLP) solutions suited to the organization's financial cloud infrastructure.
Assessment & Testing:
Collaborate with the Pentest team to conduct periodic penetration testing on cloud infrastructure; assess the security of cloud services before deployment to Production.
DevSecOps:
Integrate automated security testing tools (SAST/DAST) into CI/CD pipelines, promoting a DevSecOps culture throughout the packaging and deployment of financial applications on the cloud.
Compliance:
Ensure the multi-cloud infrastructure consistently complies with strict financial industry security standards such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, and regulations issued by the State Bank of Vietnam.

Koidra isn't just building software; we are building the
brain
for
industrial automation

Django Ninja, Pydantic and PostgreSQL through Vue 3.5, and TanStack Query, deployed on Kubernetes with Helm.

: architect and review the agents that write most of the code. You define what "good" means here and encode it as types, rules and tests instead of repeating it in prompts.

You care about the “why” and the “how”. You can explain the whys and whys not of the engineering decisions, whether made by yourself or your AI agents.

About Flexspace AI
Flexspace AI is the e-commerce + AI revenue platform for coworking — / Shopify / Airbnb for flexible workspace. Seed-funded. We turn operators' websites into high-converting storefronts and run AI agents that price and market their inventory in real time.
What we ship
: mobile-first booking engine that embeds in any operator's site; SmartPricing Agent for dynamic pricing on meeting rooms, day passes, offices; SmartMarketing Agent for promo campaigns; operator dashboard for revenue/bookings/attribution; member portal for end customers; two-way integrations with prominent property management systems.
Who buys it
: coworking operators from single-location indies to multi-country brands. Their revenue is the conversion rate of the screens you'll design — CTAs, catalog, transitions, and checkout aren't decoration here; they're the product.
How we work
: small, agile, AI-heavy. On track to profitability this year. Headcount is deliberately small so each person owns real surface area — tight feedback loops, no bureaucracy, no committees. We measure shipped work — funnel lifts, partner themes shipped, UX issues triaged — not hours. No face-time theater.
Co-located hybrid out of Workflow Thao Dien in HCMC for in-person speed. Wider team is async-first, written-first across US, Israel, Turkey, Philippines, and Vietnam. Weekly product/design sync with the CTO/cofounder — no layers between you and the people deciding what to build.
Role Overview
Product Engineer building the e-commerce platform behind the next generation of coworking spaces—SmartPricing, SmartMarketing, the booking engine operators embed on their sites, and the integrations that tie it all together. You work directly with the founders, with no layers between you and the people setting the roadmap. We also welcome final-year students looking for an internship.
What engineering means here.
The hard problem isn't writing code—AI writes plenty of it now. It's deciding what's worth building. Operators juggle hundreds of spaces, prices, members, bookings, and integrations across locations and time zones; customers comparing meeting rooms decide in seconds. Your job is to understand these humans—in the data—then ship software that moves their revenue. Empathy and data are the input; working product is the output. Polish comes last.
On prioritization.
Not all code has the same payoff. You'll look at a problem from several angles—funnel data, operator feedback, revenue, churn signals—and pick the work where your hours move the business most. A feature nobody uses is wasted hours; a 2% lift on the booking funnel is the company's quarter. Judgment over completeness.
On decisions.
Bigger calls go to the team before you build. Smaller calls—ship, watch the data, iterate. We're data-driven, not opinion-driven, and seniority doesn't win arguments—evidence does. You'll own the surfaces you touch, with support, and you expose your reasoning so we can calibrate together.
On growth.
You're early-career, and we hire for that on purpose. Expect code review, pairing, and direct coaching from founders and senior engineers. We can teach the stack, the patterns, and the product thinking. The one thing we can't give you is drive—that comes from you.
What You'll Do
Ship features end-to-end.
Work with founders and operators to understand a need, then spec, build, and release it—with support along the way.
Build and evolve our SmartPricing & SmartMarketing agents.
Pricing rules, targeting logic, and performance monitoring.
Make booking effortless.
Seamless booking experiences with instant payment, embedded right in operators' websites.
Wire up integrations.
Sync data with coworking CRMs, inventory systems, and analytics tools—and prevent double bookings.
Pull data, form an opinion, decide.
Revenue, Mixpanel, GA4 / GTM funnel data, and operator feedback.
Write so the team stays in sync.
Clear specs and pull-request descriptions that keep an async, distributed team aligned across time zones.
How You'll Work With AI
Claude as peers, not novelties. You'll write and refine structured prompts, build new ones, and ship real changes through AI tools. Senior engineers coach you and set guardrails so you can move fast without first becoming a framework expert. Judgment, taste, and clear thinking are the bottleneck now—not syntax. We give you a budget for the best AI tools because we expect you to use them as leverage, not as a crutch.
What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months
You've shipped real features to production that operators and members actually use.
You can navigate the codebase and pick up unfamiliar areas without much hand-holding.
You ship changes through Claude with sound judgment about what to accept and what to rework.
You back your decisions and pushback with data—and your written updates keep the async team moving without meetings.
You're catching product, UX, and trade-off issues early, not just implementing tickets.
What Makes You a Great Fit
We prioritize these qualities top-down—technical skills can be learned quickly by sharp, curious people with low ego and a strong work ethic. Above all, here's what we look for:
Drive and motivation.
We can give you the tools, the environment, and hands-on coaching—but we can't give you the drive to succeed as a product engineer in the modern AI era. That has to come from you.
Attention to detail and high standards.
You're obsessed with quality—it's not about just getting the job done, it's about delivering the best work you can and raising the team's bar. You sweat the small things—edge cases, copy, data correctness—because details separate a working product from a trusted one.
Clear written English.
You read and write clear English (with the help with AI tools); in an async, globally distributed team, your writing is how you think, collaborate, and lead.
High agency.
You take initiative—ask questions when something's unclear, chase down answers, and push your work forward instead of waiting to be told the next step.
You question everything.
Everyone has a voice and is expected to push the envelope. There's no "the senior person knows better"—answers and pushback alike are grounded in data and critical thinking, regardless of title or age.
Curiosity and fast learning.
You pick up new domains, tools, and concepts quickly, especially around AI, pricing, and B2B SaaS.
Product sense.
You care about customers and business context, not just the tech stack, and you treat engineering as a way to drive revenue, bookings, and occupancy. You grasp basic microeconomics—incentives, opportunity cost, supply and demand—as a toolkit for trade-offs: simpler designs that still maximize value, arguments made in terms of impact rather than opinion, and an understanding of why the business prioritizes what it does. Don't have this thinking framework yet? If you bring the motivation, we'll coach you on it.

About SkyLab
SkyLab is a Singapore-headquartered AI infrastructure company operating across Southeast and North Asia. We design, build and operate GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) environments on the latest NVIDIA platforms for AI model developers and enterprises, whose training and inference workloads depend on every node and link being healthy, 24 hours a day.
About the role
The DevOps team builds and runs the platform that keeps it that way. Our monitoring and automation stack watches hundreds of GPU servers across every site, covering hardware health, network fabric and alerting that gets the right people involved quickly. As new sites come online across the region, each one joins this platform from day one.
You will join the team that owns it end to end. Everything is infrastructure-as-code, reviewed through merge requests, and runs on-premises rather than on public cloud.
You will work closely with our Data Center Operations team and with engineers overseas, so clear written English is an important part of the job.
Key responsibilities
Observability:
operate and improve a multi-site monitoring platform, where each site keeps working on its own and a central NOC gives fleet-wide visibility.
Hardware and network health:
use out-of-band server data and network telemetry to spot issues with GPUs, nodes and links early.
Automation:
automate provisioning, configuration and deployment as code, and keep the CMDB accurate so it drives discovery and alerting.
AI-augmented operations:
apply AI tools and agents to reduce manual work, such as alert triage, incident summaries and runbook automation, and use AI assistants to write and review code faster.
Alerting:
tune alerts to be clear and actionable, and keep the runbooks behind them up to date.
Troubleshooting:
investigate issues across hardware, network, OS and application layers, find the root cause, and share what was learned.
Reliability and security:
help maintain highly available services, backup and recovery plans, secrets, and regular patching.
CI/CD and tooling:
improve pipelines and build internal tools that make changes easier and safer for other teams.
Collaboration:
document your work and partner with Data Center Operations and overseas engineers on design and problem-solving.
Our toolset:
Prometheus/Grafana stack, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes (k3s), Proxmox, GitLab CI, NetBox (CMDB), Jira and PagerDuty.

About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
Job Description
Get to Know the Team
The Streaming Data team (aka "Coban") strives to enable seamless and secure real-time access to the continuous events or "streams", serving as Grab's unified, common access pattern for real-time data. We build the platform for writing, consuming, enriching and retrieving real-time data, and provide a cost-effective, fully managed "NoOps" service for all product teams to leverage.
Get to know the team
The functional areas this team covers are streaming (Kafka/AutoMQ), in-house streaming SDK, stream processing framework (Flink, Flink SQL, Kafka Connect), Change Data Capture, stream exploration (Zeppelin, Flink SQL Gateway), as well as an in-house control plane for tenancy and resource management.
Our customers are engineers, analysts, and data scientists at Grab (across all verticals like Transport, Deliveries, Geo, Ads, and various Fintech verticals), who leverage realtime data for state machines, pub/sub architectures, insights and reporting, forecasting and anomaly detection, as well as online feature engineering. The team is responsible for mission critical systems and clusters that ingest and process 10s of TB of data every hour and make streaming data simple, convenient and reliabily for engineers across Grab to use.
Get to Know the Role
Senior Engineers are expected to be significant and autonomous contributors to their team, trusted with designing, shipping, operating and monitoring software systems in a consistently high-quality manner. You would work on the Golang components of the team, such as our in-house streaming SDK, control planes, etc , considering the appropriate architectural patterns, code design, and infrastructure options, ensuring that you deliver a secure, reliable, testable, maintainable, extensible, and well-tested system.
You will report to the Engineering Manager II and will work onsite at CMC Creative Space, Tan Hung ward, HCMC

Work with a team of cross functional engineers to make Data Streaming and Stream Processing easy and reliably across Grab, primarily via self-served capabilities baked in our control plane and streaming SDK.
Write go code that is well tested across the test pyramid/trophy (unit, integration, end-to-end) and can be maintained by a cross functional team.
Implement and drive large-scale technical initiatives, ensuring seamless platform evolution across the organization
Weigh in on design questions around platformization, infrastructure, observability and security, and work closely with (and build over the platforms provided by) our infrastructure team.
Participate in and evolve on-call and incident response procedures for the team.

Nhân sự AI tại MB sẽ tham gia các dự án khác nhau tùy theo thế mạnh chuyên môn và nhu cầu phát triển năng lực của bản thân, có thể kể đến các mảng công việc sau:
1. Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML toàn diện (end-to-end), như LLM, pipeline RAG, semantic search), AI Agent, chatbot, fraud detection.
2. Thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML trong lĩnh vực Thị giác máy tính (Computer Vision), bao gồm eKYC, OCR, segmentation, classification, camera AI.
3. Coding, test metrics, service và unit test theo mô hình DevOps, MLOps
4. Tích hợp và tối ưu hóa quy trình làm việc AI bằng các framework và công cụ như LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face,...
5. Nghiên cứu và áp dụng các nghiên cứu mới ( SOTA) như Reinforcement Learning, Self-Supervised Learning và Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning...
Với nhóm ứng viên là sinh viên tài năng và fresher: yêu cầu tham gia các chương trình đào tạo và dự án mới tại MB để để phát triển lên các vị trí Kỹ sư cấp cao tại MB trong tương lai gần

:

- Thành thạo một trong các ngôn ngữ: Python, C/C++.

- Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng ít nhất 01 framework AI/ML phổ biến như: PyTorch, TensorFlow,...
- Nắm vững các mô hình và thuật toán Machine Learning/Deep Learning như: Supervised Learning, Reinforcement Learning; CNN, Transformer...
- Có kinh nghiệm về tối ưu mô hình: Knowledge Distillation, Model Pruning, Model Quantization, Inference Optimization...

Có kinh nghiệm nghiên cứu hoặc triển khai các bài toán về:
+  Computer Vision (CV), Image Processing, Video Analytics, eKYC, Document AI.
+ Natural Language Processing (NLP)
+ Speech/Audio Processing.
+ Fraud Detection
4. MLOps & AI Deployment
Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng:  Git, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow, TensorFlow Serving, Triton Inference Server"

skills: NodeJS, API, AI, TypeScript, English, Python

job_description:
About Everfit
Everfit is one of the fastest growing fitness coaching platforms in the world. We power more than 320,000 coaches across the globe with an all-in-one AI-powered platform to run and grow their businesses. In 6 years, we have become one of the leaders of the health and wellness B2B SaaS category in the US and around the world! We are at an inflection point. We are focusing our efforts to capture more of the $5.1 trillion health and fitness market by going direct to consumers. Our vision is to become the operating system for personal health, where anyone can plug in a coach, or multiple coaches, to reach their wellness goals faster, optimize their human potential, and extend their longevity.
Our team spans from San Francisco to Vietnam, with senior leaders who have built and scaled products at Netflix, Apple, Meta, Nike, Hulu, Uber, Amazon, Hypebeast, and Quibi. We are building the next unicorn to come out of Vietnam, and we are looking for a confident leader who can help us get there.
Position Overview:
As an Applied AI Engineer at Everfit, you'll work at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, building the scalable systems and AI-powered experiences that shape the future of fitness coaching for coaches and their clients around the world.
This is not a Backend role with AI sprinkled on top. Expect roughly 70% of your work on LLM-powered systems (agent workflows, RAG, tool calling, evals) and 30% on the core backend services that power them.
Your impact:
What you'll build
Durable, long-running AI workflows on Temporal: scheduled jobs and multi-step agent processes that survive restarts, retries, and partial failures.
Reliable AI pipelines with validation, retries, fallbacks, guardrails, and observability.
Systems designed around AI-specific constraints: latency, token cost, model failures, quality.
Production integrations with OpenAI and Anthropic models.
The path from experiment to production: take a validated AI capability from the AI team and ship it as a service with clear reliability, cost, and quality characteristics.
Evals and monitoring that define how AI features are measured, and catch regressions before users do.
How you'll work
Scalable backend services in Node.js/TypeScript, with system architecture, technical design, and code review across Everfit's backend.
Rapid experiments with emerging AI tech, turning the successful ones into production solutions.
Day-to-day with Product Managers, AI Engineers, and QA, from technical discovery through delivery.
Investigating production issues and improving AI workflows from real user feedback.
Helping the broader engineering org adopt AI-native development practices.
skills_and_experience:
4+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
Comfortable communicating in English and working with an international team.
Strong programming experience (preferably Node.js / TypeScript / Python) and backend architecture. Our core backend is Node.js/TypeScript and our AI services are Python/FastAPI; you'll work mainly in Node but should be comfortable crossing into Python when the work lives there.
Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases, and scalable system design.
Strong experience with databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
You have shipped at least one LLM-powered feature to production for real users, working directly with OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, and can talk concretely about its failure modes, evals, latency, and cost.
You already use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex) daily, and you review what they produce with judgment about architecture, security, and edge cases.
Comfortable experimenting with new AI tools and technologies and turning successful experiments into production solutions.
Curious, proactive, and excited about how AI can fundamentally change software development and product experiences.
[Nice to have]
Experience with Python / FastAPI or AI-focused backend development.
Experience building production LLM features, RAG pipelines, or agentic systems.
Familiarity with the stack we run in production: Pydantic/LangGraph, Qdrant for vector search, Langfuse for LLM observability, and MCP.
Experience with AWS, Docker, message queues, or cloud-native architecture.
Experience improving engineering productivity through AI, with measurable impact.
Experience working with health, fitness, wellness, personalization, or recommendation systems.
Open-source contributions or personal projects involving AI.
