Are you passionate about video games, art, and the incredible new world of AI technology? We are looking for a highly motivated and creative individual to join our team as a
Junior Generative Game Artist
. This is a fantastic entry-level opportunity to begin your career at the intersection of art and artificial intelligence.
In this role, you will learn from our senior artists and assist in creating game assets using cutting-edge generative AI tools like Midjourney, ChatGPT, Gemini Nano Banana, Layer.ai, and OpenArt.ai. Your primary tool for refining and finishing these assets will be Adobe Photoshop. If you have a good artistic eye, a love for learning, and a foundational knowledge of Photoshop, we want to help you grow into a key member of our creative team.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in Asset Creation:
Support the art team by using AI tools to generate initial concepts for characters, environments, and props based on guidance from senior artists.
Learn Prompt Engineering:
Under mentorship, you will learn and apply basic-to-intermediate prompt engineering techniques to generate images that align with the project's art style.
Image Refinement and Cleanup:
Use your Adobe Photoshop skills to perform essential post-production tasks, including cleaning up artifacts, making color corrections, compositing elements, and preparing AI-generated images for in-game use.
Asset Management:
Help organize, name, and maintain the growing library of AI-generated assets to ensure the team can access them easily.
Experiment and Learn:
Actively participate in training sessions and spend time experimenting with our suite of AI tools to develop your skills.
Support the Team:
Provide general support to the art department as needed, contributing to a positive and collaborative studio culture.
skills_and_experience:
Passion for Art & AI:
You must have a genuine interest in both digital art and the possibilities of generative AI.
Photoshop Proficiency:
Basic to intermediate proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, with a minimum of
6 to 12 months
of consistent use for personal or academic projects.
A Creative Portfolio:
A portfolio is required, but professional experience is not. We want to see your potential! Please include any digital art, drawings, or personal projects made with AI tools (Midjourney, etc.) that showcase your creativity and artistic eye.
Good Artistic Foundation:
A basic understanding of composition, color, and lighting.
Eagerness to Learn:
A strong desire to be trained, listen to feedback, and rapidly develop new skills in a fast-paced environment.
Good Communication Skills:
Ability to communicate in English and/or Vietnamese within a team setting.
Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)
Experience with other digital art software like Clip Studio Paint, Procreate, etc.
Personal experience creating a small game or mod.
Familiarity with the basic concepts of 3D modeling (e.g., playing with Blender).
Active participation in online art or AI art communities.

Gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art automation and AI tools.
Receive mentorship from industry-leading experts.
Enjoy flexible working hours tailored to your schedule.
Opportunity for a full-time role based on performance.

job_description:
What This Role Is
At Zeya Labs, we build enterprise software that delivers real business value — which means quality isn't a checkpoint at the end, it's built into how we work. As a Senior QA Engineer (Automation), you will own quality across the full software development lifecycle, from test strategy through release validation, for applications that our customers run their operations on.
You will design and maintain the automation frameworks that keep our regression, API, and integration testing fast and reliable, while also driving the practices — defect management, root cause analysis, release sign-off — that let the wider team ship with confidence. This is a hands-on technical role and a quality-leadership role at the same time: you write the scripts, and you also set the standard other engineers are held to.
Concretely, you are responsible for three things:
End-to-End QA Ownership
Lead QA activities across the full software development lifecycle — test planning, execution, defect management, and release validation
Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts for web, API, and regression testing
Create test strategies, test plans, and test cases, and hold the line on quality standards across releases
Perform functional, integration, regression, API, and database testing across enterprise applications
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure delivery quality
Own the defect lifecycle end to end — triage, root cause analysis, and the continuous-improvement loop that follows
Support UAT, deployment validation, production verification, and post-go-live activities
Mentor junior QA engineers and champion QA best practices across the team
skills_and_experience:
What We Are Looking For
5–8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, including automation testing
Strong experience with automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or similar
Experience in API testing and automation (Postman, REST Assured, or similar)
Experience with enterprise applications — Finance, ERP, Estate Management, or other business workflow systems
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, testing processes, and defect management
Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar)
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
You Will Work Across
This role spans multiple layers of the QA function depending on release needs:
Automated test frameworks spanning web, API, and regression suites
Enterprise domains such as Finance, ERP, Estate Management, and business workflow systems
CI/CD pipelines, embedding automated testing directly into the delivery process
UAT, deployment validation, and production verification through to post-go-live support
Mentoring and QA process improvement across the wider engineering team
Nice to have: experience leading QA activities or mentoring QA teams, and exposure to cloud-based applications or performance testing
There's no quality function to coast on here — you are building and running it. We're looking for someone who treats automation as a craft, not a checkbox, and who wants ownership over how quality gets built into enterprise software from the ground up.

job_description:
We are building and operating a fintech and BNPL platform that includes backend APIs, batch processes, databases, mobile and web applications, and integrations with banks, merchants, and other external partners.
We are looking for a
Senior Backend & Platform Engineer
who is strong in backend development and also comfortable working with the infrastructure on which backend systems run.
This is primarily a backend engineering role, not a dedicated DevOps or SRE position.
Your main responsibility will be designing, implementing, and improving backend systems. At the same time, we expect you to be able to understand and work with production infrastructure, including Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, databases, networking, deployment workflows, and monitoring.
You do not need to be a frontend or mobile engineer. We are looking for someone whose engineering strengths extend from
Backend to Infrastructure and Production Operations
.
Our infrastructure runs primarily on FPT Cloud and Kubernetes, and approximately 70% is already managed through Terraform and Git. You will work with our existing infrastructure engineer to operate and improve this environment, share infrastructure knowledge and responsibilities across the engineering team, and reduce reliance on individual engineers.
Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, reliability engineering, or security is highly valuable, but these are not separate specialist responsibilities for this role. We are looking first for a strong backend engineer who can confidently work across the boundary between application and infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities
Backend Development
Design, implement, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, batch processes, and system integrations.
Work with Product Managers, Business Analysts, architects, and other engineers to translate requirements into reliable technical solutions.
Design APIs, data models, asynchronous processes, error handling, retries, and recovery flows.
Improve the reliability, maintainability, performance, and observability of existing backend systems.
Investigate and resolve production issues across applications, databases, external integrations, and infrastructure.
Review code and technical designs and provide clear, constructive feedback.
Create automated tests and integrate them into the existing development and release process.
Improve backend architecture, reusable components, development practices, documentation, and technical standards.
Platform & Infrastructure
Understand and work with our existing FPT Cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, databases, monitoring, and deployment environment.
Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot backend applications running on Kubernetes.
Read, review, and safely modify existing Terraform and other infrastructure configuration through Git-based workflows.
Work with our existing infrastructure engineer to share infrastructure knowledge, operational responsibilities, and technical decisions across multiple engineers.
Help move manually managed infrastructure and configuration into reproducible code where practical.
Troubleshoot production problems that may cross application, database, network, container, or infrastructure boundaries.
Contribute to improvements in infrastructure reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost efficiency.
CI/CD & Production Operations
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows for backend applications.
Improve deployment safety through appropriate testing, automation, rollback procedures, and operational checks.
Work with logs, metrics, alerts, dashboards, and other observability tools to understand production behavior.
Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and preventive improvements.
Help ensure that critical services have practical backup, restoration, rollback, and recovery procedures.
Automate repetitive development and operational tasks where doing so improves reliability and engineering efficiency.
Create and maintain practical technical documentation and operational runbooks.
Security Contribution
Security is not the primary responsibility of this role. However, engineers working with backend systems and infrastructure should understand fundamental security principles and consider them as part of normal engineering work.
Candidates with relevant experience may also contribute to areas such as:
Authentication, authorization, access control, and secure API implementation.
Cloud IAM, network controls, secrets management, and secure infrastructure configuration.
Dependency, container, and secret scanning.
Technical remediation of findings from external penetration tests or vulnerability assessments.
Deep security specialization, penetration testing, and security governance are not required for this position.
What We Expect in the First Stage
During your initial months, we expect you to:
Understand our existing backend architecture, Rails applications, databases, external integrations, and production environment.
Begin contributing independently to backend development and increase the team’s implementation capacity.
Understand the existing Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring, and production-operation workflows.
Work with our existing infrastructure engineer to identify undocumented knowledge, manually managed resources, operational risks, and single points of failure.
Begin taking ownership of selected infrastructure changes and production operations through reviewed, Git-based workflows.
Identify practical opportunities to improve backend maintainability, infrastructure reliability, deployment safety, monitoring, and operational efficiency.
We do not expect you to redesign or independently own the entire infrastructure from day one. The goal is to gradually expand shared ownership of both backend systems and the production platform.
Preferred Personal Characteristics
We are looking for an experienced backend engineer who is comfortable going beyond application code when necessary.
Strong Backend Foundation:
You can independently design and implement reliable production backend systems rather than only completing narrowly defined tasks.
Production Mindset:
You care about what happens after code is merged and understand that deployment, infrastructure, monitoring, and operations are part of building reliable software.
Cross-Layer Problem Solving:
When something fails in production, you are comfortable investigating beyond the application layer into databases, containers, networking, infrastructure, or external services.
Ownership:
You take responsibility for outcomes and follow problems through to resolution.
Practical Engineering Judgment:
You evaluate technical decisions based on reliability, maintainability, operational effort, security, cost, and business impact.
Collaborative Engineering:
You share knowledge, document important decisions, review changes, and help prevent technical knowledge from becoming dependent on a single person.
Continuous Improvement:
You look for practical ways to improve backend systems, infrastructure, development workflows, and production operations.

Dữ liệu được cung cấp qua ứng dụng web SalesNow, tích hợp Salesforce và HubSpot, Data API, SalesNow MCP (dùng trực tiếp từ các AI agent như Claude và Cursor), và hỗ trợ triển khai AI.
※Phạm vi thay đổi công việc phải đảm nhiệm: Có.
＜Thách thức kỹ thuật＞
Thu thập và nạp dữ liệu
Thiết kế và triển khai hệ thống web scraping quy mô lớn, trích xuất dữ liệu có cấu trúc một cách ổn định từ nhiều nguồn khác nhau.
Xây dựng pipeline tích hợp API cho các nguồn dữ liệu đối tác, kèm kiểm tra schema và phát hiện bất thường.
Thiết kế pipeline nạp dữ liệu thời gian thực cho cập nhật hằng ngày, với mục tiêu độ trễ dưới một phút.
Biến đổi và chất lượng dữ liệu
Xây dựng và duy trì các model dbt chuyển dữ liệu thô sang schema thống nhất của SalesNow.
Định nghĩa SLA chất lượng dữ liệu (độ chính xác, độ đầy đủ, độ mới) và xây dashboard giám sát cảnh báo trước khi khách hàng nhận ra vấn đề.
Triển khai entity resolution và khử trùng lặp ở quy mô lớn: đối sánh bản ghi doanh nghiệp giữa các nguồn có định dạng, quy ước đặt tên và định danh khác nhau.
Hạ tầng và điều phối
Điều phối các Airflow DAG phức tạp xuyên suốt thu thập, biến đổi, làm giàu và phân phối dữ liệu.
Tối ưu cụm PostgreSQL và Elasticsearch / OpenSearch (hơn 100 triệu document trong chỉ mục tìm kiếm) để truy vấn phản hồi ở mức mili giây.
Thiết kế pipeline chịu lỗi, tự phục hồi sau sự cố, với khả năng quan sát rõ ràng ở mọi giai đoạn.
Tích hợp AI pipeline
Đưa dữ liệu có cấu trúc vào các RAG pipeline và hệ thống AI agent thông qua SalesNow MCP.
Xây dựng lớp phân phối dữ liệu để AI agent truy vấn theo thời gian thực cho quy trình của khách hàng doanh nghiệp.
Làm việc với Amazon Bedrock, Claude và Gemini để cải thiện cách hệ thống AI sử dụng dữ liệu doanh nghiệp có cấu trúc.
Bài toán chúng tôi đang giải
Xác định một tin tuyển dụng còn mở hay đã đóng. Logic phát hiện đóng tin hiện chia thành ba hệ thống và hành vi khác nhau tùy nguồn. Một số nguồn không hiển thị trạng thái đóng trên trang danh sách, nên phương pháp so sánh chênh lệch có thể đóng nhầm khi crawl bị lỗi tạm thời.
Thiết kế quy trình thu thập thông tin website của mọi doanh nghiệp và theo dõi liên tục các thay đổi.
Một lần rà soát chất lượng dữ liệu
Khi để AI kiểm chứng độc lập logic suy luận doanh nghiệp khách hàng đứng sau các tin tuyển dụng freelance, chỉ 12 trên 100 trường hợp xác định được với bằng chứng rõ ràng. Chúng tôi đã sửa lại logic để chỉ kết luận khi có căn cứ.
＜Cách chúng tôi làm việc với AI＞
Mọi người đều dùng được Claude và Gemini. Chúng tôi cũng dùng Codex và chọn model theo từng loại công việc.
Chúng tôi nhờ nhiều LLM review công việc, còn con người kiểm tra căn cứ và quyết định áp dụng hay không. Với kiểm tra dữ liệu, chúng tôi dùng LLM as a Judge theo tiêu chí do con người đặt ra.
Sau khi thống nhất mục tiêu và ngân sách, người phụ trách tự quyết định cách tiến hành và dùng AI ở đâu.
Mọi vị trí đều được kỳ vọng tự tái thiết kế công việc của mình bằng AI. Ban lãnh đạo của chúng tôi cũng viết code.
＜Môi trường làm việc xuyên ngôn ngữ＞
Rào cản ngôn ngữ đã được giải quyết bằng quy trình, không phải bằng nỗ lực cá nhân.
PRD đầy đủ và chính xác
. Công việc được giao kèm PRD, nên bạn biết rõ cần làm gì trước khi bắt đầu, và hai bên thống nhất được thời hạn.
GitHub, Notion, Slack đều có dịch thuật.
Pull request, tài liệu và trao đổi hằng ngày đều đi qua công cụ dịch, nên bạn đọc và viết bằng ngôn ngữ mình thoải mái nhất.
Công cụ dịch AI do công ty chi trả.
Thành viên không nói tiếng Nhật trao đổi công việc qua phiên dịch đồng thời bằng AI. Phỏng vấn cũng vậy.
Kết quả: bạn dành thời gian cho thiết kế và code, không phải cho việc vật lộn với ngôn ngữ.

Tích lũy kinh nghiệm AI tại một công ty Nhật tự phát triển sản phẩm
Đây không phải công ty outsourcing. Bạn xây dựng sản phẩm của chính công ty, cho thị trường Nhật Bản, và tự quyết định thiết kế. Kinh nghiệm đưa LLM vào quy trình xử lý dữ liệu production — vừa kiểm soát chi phí vừa kiểm soát độ chính xác — là thứ hiếm có ở bất kỳ đâu.

Làm việc hoàn toàn từ xa
100% remote. Làm việc từ Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng hay bất kỳ nơi nào có kết nối internet ổn định. Không yêu cầu lên văn phòng.

Chi tiêu cho công cụ AI trung bình trên 600 USD mỗi người mỗi tháng, do công ty chi trả. Đây là số tiền thực tế đã chi, không phải hạn mức trên giấy.

Giờ làm việc: Giờ cốt lõi 10:00〜19:00 giờ Nhật Bản, tương đương 8:00〜17:00 giờ Việt Nam. Ngoài giờ cốt lõi là flextime.
Ngày nghỉ lễ theo lịch Việt Nam.
Bạn nghỉ theo các ngày lễ của Việt Nam (Tết Nguyên Đán, Giỗ Tổ Hùng Vương, 30/4, 1/5, Quốc khánh 2/9), không phải theo lịch Nhật Bản.
Nghỉ phép: Theo luật lao động Việt Nam.

Địa điểm: 100% từ xa.

Công cụ AI: chi tiêu trung bình trên 600 USD mỗi người mỗi tháng (công ty chi trả).
Công cụ dịch thuật AI cho giao tiếp xuyên ngôn ngữ (công ty chi trả).
Thiết bị làm việc do công ty cấp.

Xét hồ sơ (CV + trả lời ngắn 3 câu hỏi kỹ thuật).
Ngày tuyển chọn tập trung, tổ chức trực tuyến trong một ngày: bài tập về data pipeline theo tình huống thực tế (2-3 giờ), phỏng vấn kỹ thuật (60 phút) về bài tập và kinh nghiệm của bạn, và trao đổi với engineering lead (30 phút).

Chúng tôi đưa ra offer sau ngày tuyển chọn.

Chúng tôi là nhà tuyển dụng bình đẳng và đánh giá ứng viên dựa trên kỹ năng, kinh nghiệm và tiềm năng.

Collaborate with security engineers to translate offensive and defensive domain expertise into agent behavior, tool profiles, and decision logic

HRS is a global technology company transforming how businesses manage lodging and meetings through AI-driven, data-centric solutions. With more than 50 years of experience, HRS serves global enterprises, hotel partners, and business travelers through Lodging-as-a-Service, Meeting-as-a-Service, and Workforce-as-a-Service offerings.
Business Unit
The Search & Book unit at HRS plays a pivotal role in delivering innovative solutions through HRS Connect, the company's flagship product within the expansive global corporate travel management market. HRS Connect specifically targets the rapidly growing and significantly underserved segments of corporate lodging, meetings, groups, and long stays. The unit develops, enhances, and maintains complex technology solutions that seamlessly integrate hotel distribution systems, Property Management Systems (PMS), Online Travel Agencies (OTA), and Hotel Chain systems into the HRS Connect platform. Leveraging robust connectivity, innovative technology, and data-driven insights, the unit ensures seamless connectivity, optimized travel spend, enhanced traveler experiences, and high-performance booking solutions for global enterprise customers.
Savings Engine is the transaction and rate intelligence backbone of Connect. Its performance directly affects booking success, rate competitiveness, customer savings, confirmation reliability, and the quality of the end-to-end traveler booking experience.
Position

This is not a pure people-management role. You will lead engineers, own delivery, stay close to architecture, and set the operating model for how the team uses AI in daily engineering work: Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted code review, test generation, regression analysis, documentation, and production diagnosis.

job_description:
Mục tiêu vị trí
Vị trí chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng, vận hành và tối ưu toàn bộ hạ tầng công nghệ trên nền tảng AWS Cloud và on-premises — đảm bảo các hệ thống giao dịch chứng khoán, ứng dụng khách hàng và hệ thống nội bộ luôn hoạt động ổn định, bảo mật và có khả năng mở rộng
Mô tả công việc
1. Thiết kế và vận hành hạ tầng Cloud (AWS)
Thiết kế, triển khai và vận hành hạ tầng AWS end-to-end: networking (VPC, subnet, route table, NAT/Internet Gateway, Security Group), compute (EC2, ECS, EKS), storage (S3, EBS, EFS) và managed services.
Cấu hình và vận hành kết nối bảo mật giữa các môi trường và đối tác qua VPC Peering, Transit Gateway, VPN Site-to-Site và AWS PrivateLink.
Quản lý DNS với Route 53, cân bằng tải với ALB/NLB, bảo vệ edge với CloudFront và AWS WAF; đảm bảo phân vùng mạng và kiểm soát traffic theo yêu cầu bảo mật tài chính.
Vận hành workload container trên ECS hoặc EKS: thiết lập cluster, cấu hình auto scaling, quản lý node và tích hợp deployment pipeline.
Đánh giá và áp dụng serverless (Lambda, API Gateway) cho các tác vụ phù hợp nhằm tối ưu chi phí và vận hành.
2. Hạ tầng on-premises và hybrid
Quản trị hệ thống máy chủ vật lý và ảo hóa (VMware/Hyper-V); đảm bảo tính sẵn sàng và hiệu năng của hạ tầng on-premises phục vụ các hệ thống lõi.
Vận hành hệ thống mạng nội bộ: firewall, router, switch, load balancer, VPN và các kết nối liên mạng; phối hợp với đội network trong cấu hình và xử lý sự cố.
Quản lý và tối ưu hạ tầng lưu trữ (SAN/NAS), backup và disaster recovery; đảm bảo RPO/RTO phù hợp với yêu cầu của hệ thống tài chính.
Xây dựng và duy trì kiến trúc hybrid cloud: kết nối liền mạch giữa môi trường on-premises và AWS, đảm bảo tính nhất quán về bảo mật và vận hành.
3. Infrastructure as Code và tự động hóa
Định nghĩa và quản lý toàn bộ hạ tầng bằng IaC (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation hoặc CDK); kiểm soát phiên bản và thực hiện peer review trước khi áp dụng thay đổi.
Xây dựng và duy trì CI/CD pipeline cho việc triển khai hạ tầng và ứng dụng; đảm bảo quy trình deploy an toàn, có thể lặp lại và rollback khi cần.
Tự động hóa các tác vụ vận hành định kỳ: provisioning, patching, scaling, configuration management; giảm thiểu thao tác thủ công và rủi ro lỗi người dùng.
Duy trì các module, template và chuẩn hạ tầng tái sử dụng; đảm bảo tính nhất quán giữa các môi trường DEV, SIT, UAT và Production.
4. Bảo mật hạ tầng và tuân thủ
Quản lý identity và access với IAM: thiết kế role, policy, least privilege và federation; phối hợp với đội bảo mật trong kiểm soát quyền truy cập.
Triển khai mã hóa dữ liệu at-rest và in-transit với KMS, quản lý certificate và xử lý secrets an toàn với Secrets Manager hoặc Parameter Store.
Vận hành công cụ bảo mật và governance: GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, Inspector; xử lý các phát hiện bảo mật trong thời hạn quy định.
Hỗ trợ kiểm toán, compliance và các yêu cầu quản lý nhà nước liên quan đến hạ tầng công nghệ của công ty chứng khoán; cung cấp bằng chứng kiểm soát và tài liệu kỹ thuật khi cần.
5. Giám sát, quan sát hệ thống và xử lý sự cố
Xây dựng hệ thống monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboard và alerting với CloudWatch kết hợp Prometheus, Grafana hoặc ELK Stack.
Định nghĩa và theo dõi SLO/SLA cho các hệ thống quan trọng; đảm bảo hạ tầng đáp ứng cam kết về availability và performance.
Tham gia on-call rotation, xử lý incident production, phân tích root cause và triển khai biện pháp ngăn lỗi tái diễn; cập nhật runbook và post-incident report.
Thực hiện kiểm tra định kỳ disaster recovery và failover; đảm bảo kế hoạch phục hồi hoạt động đúng theo thiết kế.

job_domain: IT Hardware and Computing Software Products and Web Services AI Software & Services
job_description:
Zeya Labs builds the systems, models, and data infrastructure for a group operating across broad industries — including financial services, real estate, retail, healthcare, and more — in Southeast Asia. Real backing, real scale, real stakes. Almost none of it has a technology backbone yet.
We are a small AI-native engineering team based in Ho Chi Minh City, and the central technology delivery engine for that group. We are not a consultancy. We do not hand off blueprints. We build, run, and own what we ship.
That's the opportunity here: no legacy architecture to inherit, no decade of technical debt to manage around, no entrenched way of doing things to unwind. You'd be one of the first people deciding how this gets built, secured, and run — at group scale, from close to zero.
WHAT THIS ROLE IS
This is a new, senior role, and it owns the technology function. You report to the CEO and are accountable for everything: architecture, security, testing, how software gets built and run, and the teams that build it — consistently, as we scale into new industries and new group entities. This only works if you stay close to the work. Everyone at Zeya Labs is hands-on, including you.
Concretely, the CTO is responsible for three things:
Leading AI-native delivery, for real.
You've shipped complex AI products into production, not pilots or proofs of concept — this is a hard filter. You know from experience why conventional scrum ceremonies and fixed pods are often the wrong shape for AI-native work, and you have an actual point of view on what to run instead.
Owning the engineering organization.
Building and running the team as it scales — hiring, developing engineering leadership under you, and being the technical voice the board and senior stakeholders trust without needing it re-explained.
Building the operating system.
Designing the standards for architecture, security, testing, and delivery before scale forces them on us — not after an incident makes them unavoidable.
skills_and_experience:
You have built engineering structure at an organizational level before — standards, governance, how work actually gets done — not just run a team executing inside a structure someone else designed. That's the differentiator. Plenty of people can manage delivery well; what's rare is having built the system delivery runs on, and having done it ahead of a crisis, not in response to one.
You have genuine, delivered experience shipping AI-integrated systems into production — not coursework, not demos, not a certification. You understand where AI tooling helps, where it creates fragility, and how conventional team structures often fight against how AI-native work actually gets done.
You are still hands-on and technically credible, not someone who has moved fully into frameworks and slides. Ideally you've worked inside financial services or another regulated environment, since parts of this group carry real compliance weight. You are comfortable holding your own in a board or governance conversation without hiding behind jargon.
You'd rather design the system once than firefight the same problem in every new team.
You can go from setting direction to getting hands-on when something needs it, without it feeling like a step down.
You're motivated by scale and blank space, not by inheriting something already built.

Build like a founder. Ship like Spartan.
Our clients are startups in a race: an MVP in 30 days, real traffic the day after launch. We’re looking for a
DevOps Engineer
to keep them fast, up, and cheap to run.
We don’t act like vendors. We embed. Our teams sit inside startups backed by YC, Pear VC, BlingCap, a16z, and Techstars, working beside founders and engineers from Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, and Uber. Together we ship those MVPs and scale the systems behind them to millions of users and billions of requests.
This isn’t a back-office ops seat three layers from the client. You’ll be in the founder’s Slack. Your infrastructure runs their launch. When their product survives its first traffic spike, that’s your work holding it up.
70% of our portfolio is LLM-powered. That means real GPU workloads, real traffic spikes, and real cloud bills. You’ll design the infrastructure behind it. Cursor, Claude, and Codex are default tools here, and you’ll use them to automate the boring parts.
Who Thrives at Spartan
Not every environment fits everyone, so here’s an honest picture of the teammate we’re looking for.
You’ll thrive here if:
You do whatever it takes to win. Terraform today, debugging someone’s Node service tomorrow.
You own an incident until it’s resolved, whether it started in your area or not.
You treat cost like a feature. You can tell a founder why their bill dropped 40%.
You automate the boring parts without being asked.
Some weeks will stretch you. That’s the job. But you’ll never carry it alone. A critical incident or a high-stakes migration? You won’t be the only one on it. We push each other hard because we care how far each of us can go. We win together. We lose together. Nobody gets left behind.
One last thing. We’re not filling seats. We’re looking for teammates for the battles ahead. If you read all this and something in you said yes, trust that feeling and apply. We respect people who back themselves. Every Spartan here started with that same yes.
What You’ll Do
Design and run multi-cluster, multi-cloud Kubernetes environments across AWS EKS, GCP GKE, and Azure AKS: highly available, disaster-resilient, auto-scaling.
Build GitOps-driven CI/CD pipelines with ArgoCD or FluxCD.
Tune performance, reliability, and cost. Every dollar saved is margin for the startup we serve.
Run AI infrastructure: GPU workloads, model serving, vector databases, and the inference bills that come with them.
Automate ops with AI: runbooks, incident summaries, IaC generation with Cursor and Claude.
Secure workloads: RBAC, Network Policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, vulnerability scanning.
Work with dev teams on containerization and app modernization.
Mentor engineers on Kubernetes and infrastructure practices.
Turn what you build into reusable accelerators: CI/CD templates, starter kits, monitoring setups that cut project startup time across clients.

Tech We Use
Every project brings a different stack, so in a year here you’ll touch more of this list than most engineers do in five. Two rules hold everywhere: everything as code, no click-ops. And what we adopt is decided by our engineers through an internal Tech Radar, not handed down from a slide deck.

Làm việc trong các dự án công nghệ hiện đại, có ảnh hưởng lớn.

Thiết kế, phát triển và triển khai tính năng cho hệ thống DMS / ERP, sử dụng các công cụ AI như Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot trong quy trình làm việc hằng ngày.

job_description:
Finding something that actually fits online can be frustrating. We're on a mission to change that with AI fit assistance for lingerie and apparel brands: a chat assistant and sizing quizzes that are live on real stores today. We're looking for a Full-Stack Product Engineer to help us scale it.
Position Overview
We're looking for an experienced Full-Stack Product Engineer to join our team working on our AI fit-assistance platform for lingerie and apparel brands. You'll be responsible for building and owning the client-facing half of Brarista: the integrations that connect us to the tools our clients already run on, the dashboard they live in, the flows that take a new client from signed to live, and the compliance and cost optimisation work that lets us sell to bigger brands and to become cash-positive.
If something makes onboarding faster, wins us more clients, or shows clients what Brarista is doing for their revenue, that's yours.
We're small and moving fast, and there's a lot of blank paper.
You will be the person scaling us up from software that works well on a handful of stores into an operation a non-technical person can roll out to many.
→ Contractor, full-time. 12 month contract with an initial 6 month trial.
→ Location: Anywhere in the world
→ Working timezone: UK 9am - 7pm window
→ Team: Third engineer, joining two founding engineers and the founder
→ Ideal starting date: ASAP in late September/mid October. Applications considered on a rolling basis, so apply early. This posting may close early.
Job Scope
Treat this as a guideline rather than a boundary. We’re a start-up, and everyone joins in when there’s a problem to solve.
1. Integrations - connecting us to the tools our clients already use.
Shopify first, including the App we’re building now. Then Gorgias, putting our fit assistant inside the helpdesks our clients’ support teams work in every day. After that, analytics and lifecycle tools, so our data lands where clients already look at their numbers. You’ll help decide what we integrate next, not just build what’s handed to you.
2. Client onboarding efficiency.
Bringing a client live currently takes too many manual steps and too much engineering time. Your job is to turn it into a workflow a non-technical person can run start to finish, from signed contract to live widget: catalogue import, size chart setup, brand configuration, testing, go-live. This is the highest-leverage thing you’ll do, and it’s what lets us take on more clients without adding people.
3. The client dashboard, its analytics, and how it makes money.
Our dashboard shows clients their funnel, revenue attribution, conversations and quiz insights. You’ll build on that and own the monetisation surface alongside the founder: plans, feature gating, usage metering, AI credits, overage, upgrade flows. Deciding what sits behind the paywall is part of the job, not a decision handed to you. The bar isn’t “does the feature work”, it’s “does this make the value obvious enough that a client upgrades”.
4. Our MCP server.
So we can ask questions about client performance in plain English and get live answers, instead of clicking through dashboards. A spec exists; you’ll build it and extend it as our data grows.
5. Compliance that unlocks deals.
The bigger the client, the more they ask before signing: security questionnaires, DPAs, data-processing details, evidence we handle their shoppers’ data properly. You’ll own the engineering side of that and the client-facing responses.
In practice:
building the data export and deletion flows Shopify and GDPR require, keeping our data inventory and sub-processor list current as we add integrations, supporting the ISO 27001 work already in progress, and meeting Shopify’s protected customer data requirements for the App Store launch. When a client’s legal team sends a questionnaire, you answer it, and when the answer is “we don’t do that yet”, you build it.
This isn’t a paperwork job. It’s the difference between winning an enterprise client and losing one.
6. Cost and quality as we scale.
Every conversation costs us money in AI and infrastructure. Keeping that curve flatter than our revenue curve is what gets us to cash-positive, so you’ll watch what we spend on GCP and MongoDB and engineer it down. Alongside that: automated tests around the logic that matters most, sizing and billing above all, and supporting pen testing when clients ask for it.
And running through all of it:
you’ll sit in on product feedback sessions with clients alongside the founder, hearing directly what’s confusing, what’s missing, and what they’d pay for. We think engineers build better products when they hear the complaints themselves rather than through a summary.
How will the selection looks like?
Round 1:
You will first speak directly with our founder to check mutual suitability. This will be a high-level, open-ended conversation lasting between 15 and 20 minutes.
Round 2:
The second round consists of a take-home assessment, followed by a 45-minute call to discuss your submission. Please rest assured that we never use assessments to solicit free work. The task is designed purely to give you a taste of our domain and provide the best opportunity to showcase your technical abilities.
Final Round:
Should you pass the second round, the final stage is a one-hour call. The first half will be with the wider team you would be working closely with. This is a great opportunity to ask about our culture, day-to-day work, or anything else important to you, allowing everyone to see how we vibe together. For the second half, you will have a 1-on-1 with the founder to discuss the finer details of the role before an official offer is made.
skills_and_experience:
Technical skillsets that are required for the role:
4+ years building full-stack products
- React/TypeScript on the front, Python (FastAPI) and MongoDB behind it. You've owned features end to end.
Real UX instincts.
You notice when a flow has one step too many. You'd rather ship a simpler thing than a configurable thing. When you watch someone use what you built and they hesitate, you change it.
Integration experience
, and you know what makes them fragile: webhooks arriving twice or out of order, tokens expiring, rate limits, data that doesn't reconcile.
Fast reflexes on client-facing work.
When a client hits a problem you can turn something around today rather than next sprint, without leaving a mess behind.

Analytics and attribution tooling: GA4, Klaviyo, Triple Whale
SaaS billing and usage metering - Stripe, GoCardless, credit systems
GDPR, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 experience - implementing controls, not just reading about them
Experience answering client security questionnaires or handling DPAs

Soft skillsets that are appreciated at Brarista:
Adaptable, pragmatic and collaborative, with experience working in a fast-moving start-up environment

why_love_working_here:
How you think
You handle ambiguity.
Most of what you build here starts as a rough problem, not a spec. You're comfortable working out what the thing should be, asking the questions that clear the fog, and moving before everything is certain.
You think in systems, not job titles.
You don't say "I only do backend" or "that's a frontend ticket." You follow a problem from the database through the interface to the client's revenue, because that's usually where the answer is. Product, full-stack, customer impact: one continuous thing.
You learn fast, and you use AI to learn faster.
Never built an MCP server? Not a problem, we want someone who'll understand it and ship one quickly. The skill isn't knowing everything already, it's knowing which questions to ask: what should this actually do, why is this the right approach, what's the smallest version that works, how do I test it, how do I build it in steps.
You have high ownership.
Our CEO is non-technical and still plans, designs, codes, tests and releases whole features, while running sales, fundraising and operations. That's the standard here. Be the CEO of your own career: own outcomes, not tasks, and don't wait to be chased.
How we work
Remote and async.
No layers, no middle management, no one to route your idea through.
Goal-first:
we care about what ships and what it does for clients. We don't do office politics, mandatory socials, or ceremony for its own sake. We do care about doing the work well and getting better at it, and you'll be surrounded by people who want the same.
We move fast. If you want a predictable 9-to-5 with a fully-specified backlog, we're honestly not the right fit.
What you'll get:

Direct access to the founder and founding engineers, with real ownership over what you build
Room to shape the product roadmap, not just deliver tickets
What success looks like

- you've shipped client-facing changes to the dashboard and you understand how a client goes from signup to live.
Month 3
- client onboarding is meaningfully faster and needs less engineering; Gorgias is live; the MCP server is answering real questions about client performance.
Month 6
- a non-technical team member can onboard a client end to end, clients can see their Brarista revenue impact without asking us, we've shipped a monetisation change that moved revenue, and we can answer an enterprise security questionnaire in days rather than weeks.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Brarista builds AI fit-assistance for lingerie and apparel brands — a chat assistant and sizing quizzes that are live on real stores today.
When we get a size recommendation wrong, nothing crashes and no alarm goes off. A real person is simply told the wrong size, buys the wrong bra, and sends it back. That is why this role exists: you are the person who catches things before customers do.
You'll work alongside our engineers across the sizing engine, the chat assistant, our client dashboard, and the widgets running on our clients' storefronts.
1. Verify the sizing engine.
Our system converts sizes across 11 regional systems, handles sister sizing, calculates from measurements, and applies a different size chart for every brand we support. That's thousands of combinations — far more than anyone can check by hand. You'll use Claude Code to generate exhaustive test matrices, build regression suites, and prove that a change to one brand didn't quietly break another.
2. Guard catalogue data quality.
Our product catalogue is tagged partly by AI, and every product needs a sizing category — which is what makes it billable, so mistakes here cost money directly. You'll verify AI-suggested tags, check assignments against our rules, and find the products that slipped through. This becomes one of the most important things you own.
3. Own release quality and the changelog.
You'll test what's about to ship and write the release notes our clients read. When something goes out, you're the person who can say what changed and why.
4. Triage what clients report.
Bug reports and feedback come in from clients. You'll reproduce them, work out what's actually happening, write them up so an engineer can act immediately, and close the loop with the person who reported it.

address: The Hallmark Building, 15 Tran Bach Dang Street, An Khanh, Ho Chi Minh
skills: Python, AI, LLM, Databricks, Docker, Computer Vision
job_description:
I. The Role
** This is not a research role and not a "PoC factory." You will join OCB's AI Squad — a small, elite, forward-deployed unit modeled on the Palantir Forward-Deployed Engineer and Navy SEAL operating philosophy: a few exceptional engineers who embed directly inside business divisions, find the highest-value problems, and ship production AI that moves the bank's numbers.
** You will own outcomes, not tickets. Your work is measured against two hard targets:
- Cost-to-Income Ratio (CIR) improvement — automating high-cost manual workflows (document processing, credit operations, AML/ops review, RM support) so the bank does more with the same headcount. Or:
- Revenue growth through personalization — building AI systems that lift products-per-customer, card and lending penetration, CASA, and campaign conversion by delivering the right offer to the right customer at the right time.
You embed with a division, learn its workflow better than it knows itself, build the agent or pipeline that removes the cost or unlocks the revenue, and put it into production. Then you do it again.
II. What You'll Own
1. Forward-Deployed Delivery
Embed directly with a business division (Retail, SME, Risk, Operations, AML) — sit with the operators, map the workflow end-to-end, and identify where AI removes cost or creates revenue.
Own the full lifecycle of each solution: problem framing, architecture, data pipeline, build, deployment, integration with core banking, and the business result. You are accountable for the metric, not just the model.
Ship fast and iterate in production. We measure success in deployed systems and basis points of CIR, not slide decks.
2. Personalization & Revenue Engines
Build AI systems that drive revenue through personalization: next-best-offer and next-best-action engines, pre-approved credit and lending journeys, CASA/cash-leakage retention prompts, and RM/PRM coaching assistants that tell front-line staff exactly what to pitch to whom.
Connect customer behavioral signals, product-holding data, and transaction patterns into agentic workflows that act — not dashboards that observe.
3. Cost & Operations Automation (CIR)
Build agentic and RAG workflows that collapse manual cost: credit-policy lookup, risk-analysis support, AML alert triage and case automation, and operations/RM assistant tools.
Build document-intelligence pipelines — OCR and data extraction for contracts and collateral, valuation support, signature verification, and automated document classification — using vision-language models where they earn their place.
4. Production AI Engineering
Stand up evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability for every system you ship. Banking-grade means measurable, monitored, and safe by default.
Own deployment, model serving, monitoring, and retraining. Meet SLAs. Partner with IT and infra to integrate cleanly with core banking systems (T24, Way4, LOS, OMNI) and internal platforms.
5. Squad Leadership
Set the engineering bar. Mentor junior squad members and pull business stakeholders along with you — translating workflow pain into shipped systems and shipped systems into business value.
skills_and_experience:
Experience
- 4+ years in AI/ML engineering with a real track record of production systems, not prototypes. You can point to things running in production with users and business impact behind them.
- Banking, financial services, or another regulated, security-sensitive industry is a strong plus.
- Bonus: experience as a forward-deployed / solutions / embedded engineer where you owned a customer or business outcome directly.
Core Skills
- Production-grade LangChain/LangGraph — multi-agent architectures, function calling, tool integration, stateful graphs. This is the bar.
- Strong command of advanced RAG pipeline design and agent orchestration.
- Computer Vision / VLM for OCR, document intelligence, and image analysis.
- LLMOps/MLOps: model serving (FastAPI, vLLM, Triton), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, evaluation and guardrails.
- Databricks (Delta Lake, MLflow) for data processing and scaled deployment.
How You Operate
- Outcome-obsessed. You measure your work in CIR basis points and revenue lift, not commits.
- Embedded and fearless. Comfortable sitting with operators, learning a domain cold, and owning the result in front of business leaders.
- Bias to ship. Production over PowerPoint. Fast iteration, tight feedback loops.
- Excellent communicator who can translate technical work for non-technical stakeholders. Bilingual Vietnamese/English is a strong plus.

job_description:
Chịu trách nhiệm đảm an toàn hệ thống CNTT. Trực tiếp vận hành, quản trị và tối ưu các giải pháp an ninh (Firewall, AV/EDR, DLP, NAC, PROXY). Thực hiện giám sát an toàn thông tin (SOC), phát hiện các hành vi bất thường, phân tích cảnh báo, khắc phục sự cố an ninh mạng.
Tránh nhiệm chính
Vận hành, cấu hình, duy trì hoạt động ổn định và tối ưu chính sách (Policies/Rules) cho các hệ thống: Tường lửa (Firewall/NGFW), Antivirus/EDR, Proxy, hệ thống chống thất thoát dữ liệu (DLP), và Kiểm soát truy cập mạng (NAC)
Theo dõi, phân tích các cảnh báo an ninh từ hệ thống giám sát tập trung (SIEM) và các thiết bị an ninh.
Tiếp nhận, phân loại và thực hiện xử lý ban đầu các sự cố. Phối hợp với bộ phận khác để khắc phục sự cố và điều tra nguyên nhân.
Loại bỏ False Positive và đề xuất điều chỉnh, tối ưu các rule/correlation rule nhằm nâng cao chất lượng cảnh báo.
Theo dõi các IOC, TTP và các dấu hiệu tấn công liên quan đến hệ thống CNTT
Thực hiện quét và đánh giá lỗ hổng bảo mật (Vulnerability Assessment) định kỳ cho hạ tầng mạng và thiết bị đầu cuối.
Theo dõi các CVE, cảnh báo bảo mật và thông tin Threat Intelligence có ảnh hưởng đến hệ thống CNTT.
Lập báo cáo định kỳ (tuần/tháng) hoặc đột xuất về trạng thái an toàn thông tin, tình hình vi phạm chính sách DLP/NAC.

job_description:
🎯
Position Summary
Are you a natural storyteller who loves creating content that resonates with real audiences? Are you also curious about how AI can help you work faster and think bigger? We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented individual to join our team as an AI Research & Content Generator — a content-first role where AI tools are your everyday assistant, not the main focus.
In this role, you will plan and produce a wide variety of content for Athena's games and brand — from social media posts, short videos, marketing copy, and community content to blog articles and in-game text. You'll use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, and CapCut AI to speed up ideation, drafting, and production, while your own creative judgment, writing skills, and understanding of our audience remain the heart of every piece you ship. If you love writing, storytelling, and gaming culture — and see AI as a superpower rather than a subject — we want to hear from you.
🧠
Key Responsibilities
Content Creation & Storytelling:
Write, produce, and refine content across multiple formats — social media posts (Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Discord), marketing copy, blog articles, community announcements, store-listing content, and in-game text — that reflects Athena's tone and connects with our players.
Brand Voice & Editorial Judgment:
Ensure every piece of content sounds like Athena — consistent, engaging, and audience-appropriate. Make the final call on what's good enough to publish and what needs another pass.
AI-Assisted Production:
Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, CapCut AI, ElevenLabs, etc.) as your everyday assistant to speed up brainstorming, drafting, image mockups, video editing, and translation — always with a human eye on the final output.
Content Planning:
Contribute to the content calendar, propose ideas tied to game launches, events, community moments, and pop-culture trends. Turn briefs from Marketing and Game teams into ready-to-publish assets on time.
Audience & Trend Research:
Stay close to our players and the wider gaming community. Track what's resonating on social, in Discord — and translate those insights into better content.
Light Performance Tracking:
Review basic metrics (views, engagement, shares, comments) to understand what works and what doesn't. Use those learnings to improve the next round of content.
Team Collaboration:
Work closely with Marketing, Community, Art, and Game Design teams. Take direction, share drafts early, incorporate feedback quickly, and keep everyone in the loop.
skills_and_experience:
Strong Writing Skills:
Excellent writing in Vietnamese (native-level) and English (Upper-Intermediate or higher). You can shift tone between engaging store-listing content based on given keywords (including App Name/Title, Description, and Visual Assets, etc.), playful social captions, professional press releases, and heartfelt community messages.
Storytelling Instinct:
A natural sense for what makes a story, a post, or a video actually engaging — not just informative. You've probably been writing, posting, or creating in some form for a while, even if just for fun.
Content Portfolio:
A portfolio is
nice to have
, but professional experience is not. Please share any content you've made — blog posts, social accounts you run, fanfiction, short videos, gaming reviews, Facebook Pages, TikToks, community posts, etc. We care about your voice and creativity more than your job title.
Basic AI Tool Familiarity:
Comfortable using at least 2–3 mainstream AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, CapCut AI) as part of your daily workflow. You don't need to be a prompt engineer — just curious, self-taught, and willing to keep learning.
Love for Games & Pop Culture:
A genuine interest in mobile, PC, or console games and the culture around them. You understand player language, memes, community dynamics, and what makes gamers care.
Attention to Detail:
Care about spelling, grammar, tone, and visual polish. You proofread before you publish.
Eagerness to Learn:
Open to feedback, quick to iterate, and excited to grow into a stronger content creator over time.
Good Communication:
Clear, friendly communication in English and/or Vietnamese within a team setting.
Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)
Prior experience managing a social media account, Facebook Page, TikTok channel, YouTube channel, or Discord community (even personal ones count).
Basic knowledge of SEO/ASO, social media best practices, or content performance metrics.
Basic design or video editing skills (Canva, Photoshop, CapCut, Premiere).
Familiarity with the gaming industry or streaming culture is a plus.
Prior content, copywriting, community, or marketing experience — internship or freelance is welcome.
Active presence in online communities (gaming forums, Discord servers, fandoms, creator platforms).
why_love_working_here:
Gain hands-on experience with AI tools.
Receive mentorship from industry-leading experts.
Enjoy flexible working hours tailored to your schedule.
Opportunity for a full-time role based on performance.

Product Designer

, including mobile-first consumer applications and internal operation dashboards.
You will design seamless transactional and fan-engagement experiences across web and mobile while building and maintaining a shared Design System for the entire platform.
1. Core Product Experience Design
Design end-to-end user experiences for core product journeys, including content discovery, product selection, transactions, and order-status tracking.
Design complete order-management and payment journeys across web and mobile applications.
Create fan-interaction and content-participation experiences for entertainment programs and live events.
Design consistent identity, authentication, profile, and account-management experiences across platform modules.
Translate product requirements and business rules into user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
Identify and design appropriate states for errors, empty data, loading, payment failure, cancellation, refund, and other edge cases.
Apply a mobile-first approach while ensuring consistent and responsive experiences across web, tablet, and mobile devices.
2. Design System and Internal Operation Tools
Build and maintain a shared Design System for web and mobile applications.
Define and manage design tokens, components, variants, interaction states, responsive rules, and usage guidelines.
Ensure the Design System is scalable, accessible, reusable, and practical for development teams.
Design internal dashboards and operation tools for content, inventory, orders, payments, reconciliation, and reporting.
Ensure consistency between consumer-facing products and internal operation interfaces.
Maintain visual and brand consistency across the DatVietVAC digital ecosystem.
Collaborate with engineers to align design components with frontend and mobile component libraries.
3. User Research and Experience Optimization
Collaborate with Product Owners to collect and analyze user feedback.
Conduct usability tests and use findings to improve product flows and interface designs.
Research industry standards, competitors, and emerging practices across e-commerce, entertainment, content platforms, fintech, and high-traffic applications.
Use qualitative and quantitative insights to support design decisions.
Identify usability issues, friction points, and opportunities to improve conversion and fan engagement.
Design accessible experiences that support different users, devices, screen sizes, and network conditions.
Continuously improve the product based on user feedback, operational data, and post-event learnings.
4. Design Handoff and Cross-functional Collaboration
Prepare detailed design specifications for frontend and mobile development teams.
Clearly document components, responsive behaviors, interaction states, animations, edge cases, and business rules.
Create interactive prototypes to communicate product behavior and validate solutions before development.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Backend Engineers, Frontend and Mobile Engineers, QC Engineers, and SRE/DevOps Engineers.
Participate in product discovery, requirement clarification, design reviews, sprint planning, and implementation reviews.
Review implemented interfaces to ensure alignment with approved designs and the Design System.
Present and defend design decisions using user needs, business requirements, research, and data.
Receive feedback constructively and iterate on designs when appropriate.

5 Whys

Phân tích dữ liệu (Data-driven) thay vì dựa trên cảm tính.

Luôn đặt câu hỏi:
"Người dùng sẽ cảm thấy thế nào khi click vào đây?"
Tập trung vào tính tiện dụng (Usability) và trải nghiệm cảm xúc, không chỉ là tính năng khô khan.

Chấp nhận sự thay đổi và sự không chắc chắn.

job_description:
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Security Administrator to join our technology team. This is a critical, hands-on role responsible for securing our entire digital footprint, from internal corporate systems to client-facing applications, including our proprietary solutions.
The ideal candidate is a versatile, technology-agnostic problem solver. You must be able to analyze complex environments, design robust security solutions, and execute the necessary configurations. A key part of this role is the ability to
propose the right solution for the business, whether it is a proprietary, commercial product (like Microsoft's) or an open-source alternative.
You will be responsible for monitoring our security posture, responding to threats, and proactively hardening our systems. This position requires technical knowledge of
both Microsoft environments and common open-source security platforms
, along with a good understanding of application security. You will work hand-in-hand with our engineering team to integrate security into all aspects of our technology and will provide supervisory guidance on security-related tasks, reporting directly to the Head of Technology.
Key Responsibilities
1. Analysis & Monitoring:
• Proactively monitor and analyze security alerts from our security tools to detect, investigate, and respond to potential threats.
• Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and risk analyses across all corporate and client-front systems.
• Analyze the security of our applications, identifying potential vulnerabilities in architecture and configuration, and working with engineering to prioritize remediation.
2. Solution Design & Proposal:
• Evaluate the current security posture and propose practical, effective solutions and configuration changes to mitigate risks.
• Evaluate and recommend new security technologies, comparing commercial and open-source solutions to determine the most effective and cost-efficient way to meet security objectives.
• Design secure configurations for new and existing systems and applications.
3. Execution & Configuration:
• Lead the hands-on configuration, implementation, and hardening of our Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Defender Suite, Intune).
• Install, configure, and manage a diverse range of security tools, including selected open-source platforms (SIEMs, log management, vulnerability scanners...).
• Execute remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities, including patch management and system reconfiguration.
4. Supervision & Collaboration:
• Provide technical supervision and guidance to engineering and IT team members on the correct implementation of security controls and best practices.
• Act as the primary technical point of contact for security incidents, coordinating the response between the technology team and management.
• Work closely with the Head of Technology to develop, document, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures.
• Liaise with the engineering team to ensure security is a core component of all new product development and system rollouts.

Network Security: Good understanding of network security fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs) and network protocols.

Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.
By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.

Come join our team and take ownership of
Cloud-native Test Orchestration products
used in complex telecommunications environments.

DevOps Engineer

Linux, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, and troubleshooting

Develop, configure, and support cloud-native Test Orchestration services and the platforms on which they run.

Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, quality gates, artifact handling, and release automation using tools such as Jenkins, Git/Gerrit, Artifactory or Nexus, and SonarQube.
Investigate support tickets and incidents, perform structured root-cause analysis for common issues, implement fixes, and escalate complex problems with clear evidence.
Collaborate with software developers and testers on microservice-based feature development, integration, and automated testing.
Improve platform reliability through monitoring, observability, documentation, security practices, and continuous-improvement initiatives, including pragmatic use of automation and AI-assisted engineering tools.
Communicate progress, risks, and technical findings to international stakeholders, and contribute to peer reviews, documentation, knowledge transfer, and team learning.

Solid Linux administration and troubleshooting skills in RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, or comparable distributions.
Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based engineering workflows using tools such as Jenkins, Gerrit/GitLab, artifact repositories, and SonarQube.
Good Python or Bash/Shell scripting skills, with the ability to create, maintain, and troubleshoot automation.
Good understanding of Docker, Helm, microservices, and Cloud-native deployment patterns.
Structured troubleshooting skills across applications, containers, operating systems, platform services, networking, and storage, with sound escalation judgment.
Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, ports, routing, load balancing, and common L2/L3 concepts.
Experience handling platform operations, support tickets or incidents, root-cause analysis, and clear technical documentation.
Understanding of software testing practices, including unit, integration, and functional testing.
Good written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to collaborate in distributed, cross-functional teams.
A proactive, analytical, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to own tasks, seek guidance when appropriate, and contribute to continuous improvement.
